fields.description_zh: 確認申報醫院之醫事機構代碼。
fields.description_en: Confirms the healthcare facility code of the reporting hospital.
fields.purpose_zh: 確認申報醫院。
fields.guide_zh: 各家醫院均有醫事機構代碼，依申報醫院之「健保申報代碼」填入。
fields.purpose_en: Confirms the reporting hospital.
fields.guide_en: Every hospital has a healthcare facility code; enter the reporting hospital's "NHI claim code".

fields.description_zh: 記錄個案於申報醫院之病歷號碼。
fields.description_en: Records the case's medical record number at the reporting hospital.
fields.purpose_zh: 用來辨識個案及作為調閱病歷之依據；亦可作為辨識個案是否有多重原發腫瘤之依據。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案在申報醫院之病歷號碼。
• 若病歷號碼少於10碼，則直接填入病歷號碼，資料向左靠、後面留空白；若有英文字母請大寫。
• 若病歷號碼未知，則編碼為9999999999。
fields.purpose_en: Used to identify the case and as the basis for retrieving medical records; can also be used to identify whether the case has multiple primary tumors.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the case's medical record number at the reporting hospital.
• If the medical record number has fewer than 10 characters, enter it directly, left-justified with trailing blanks; use capital letters for any letters.
• If the medical record number is unknown, code 9999999999.

fields.description_zh: 填寫個案的姓名。
fields.description_en: Enter the case's name.
fields.purpose_zh: 用來辨識個案。
fields.guide_zh:
• 本欄位不可空白，若不知道個案的姓名，則編碼為不詳。
• 若電腦中無此字，請用「？」全形字體替代；字與字中間不可空白。
fields.purpose_en: Used to identify the case.
fields.guide_en:
• This field must not be blank; if the case's name is not known, code it as "unknown" (the Chinese word for unknown).
• If a character is not available in the computer, replace it with a full-width "？"; no spaces are allowed between characters.

fields.description_zh: 記錄個案的身分證統一編號。
fields.description_en: Records the case's national ID number.
fields.purpose_zh: 用來辨識個案。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案的身分證統一編號。
• 身分證統一編號應確實詳填，並需與性別符合，身分證統一編號英文字母後第一位數字若為1則為男性，2則為女性。
• 身分證統一編號若不詳，應設法透過各種管道查證，如：詳閱病歷資料(住院許可證、手術同意書、護理紀錄單等)、醫院電腦系統、或直接向個案及相關人員查詢等。
fields.purpose_en: Used to identify the case.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the patient's national identification number.
• The national identification number must be filled in accurately and consistent with sex; if the first digit after the letter of the national identification number is 1, the patient is male, and if 2, female.
• If the national identification number is unknown, try to verify it through various channels, such as: reviewing medical record data (admission permit, surgical consent form, nursing records, etc.), the hospital computer system, or inquiring directly with the patient and related persons.

fields.description_zh: 確認個案的性別。
fields.description_en: Confirms the case's sex.
fields.purpose_zh: 可作為各癌症部位性別比例及預後之比較。個案若有多重原發，其病歷紀錄上的性別都應相同。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄病歷上個案的性別。
• 需注意個案性別應與其身分證統一編號性別碼相符合。
• 編碼4：變性人(transsexual)係指經手術方式改變原本之性別。
fields.purpose_en: Can be used to compare sex ratios and prognosis by cancer site. If a case has multiple primaries, the sex recorded in the medical record should be the same.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the patient's sex as documented in the medical record.
• Note that the patient's sex should be consistent with the sex code of the national identification number.
• Code 4: Transsexual (transsexual) refers to a person whose original sex has been changed surgically.

fields.description_zh: 確認個案的出生日期。
fields.description_en: Confirms the case's date of birth.
fields.purpose_zh: 有助於確認個案的身份；對於以個案世代研究(patient cohort)作為腫瘤分析也很有幫助。
fields.guide_zh:
• 依病歷上所記載來記錄個案的出生日期。
• 若出生日期不詳者，應設法透過各種管道查證，或直接與個案或相關人員查詢。
• 民國年換算為西元年，年度為民國前者，以「1912」減民國前年度；民國後，以「1911」加民國年度。例如民前5年為西元1907年，民國5年則為西元1916年。年 月 日使用4位數字的西元年 01 1月 01 9999 年不詳 02 2月 02 03 3月 03 … … … … 10 10月 29 11 11月 30 12 12月 31 99 月不詳 99 日不詳範例：編碼：案例
19060630：個案出生日期為民國前6年6月30 日。
19409999：個案在民國 89 年 6 月 15 日時是 60 歲，在病歷記錄中並無記載其出生日期。則記錄月份和日期未知(分別為99, 99)，並推算其出生年份為民國 29年。
19279999：病歷上僅記載個案之出生年份是民國 16年。
fields.purpose_en: Helps confirm the case's identity; also useful for tumor analysis using a patient cohort.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the case's date of birth as documented in the medical record.
• If the date of birth is unknown, try to verify it through various channels, or inquire directly with the case or related persons.
• To convert ROC years to AD years: for years before the ROC era, subtract the number of years before the ROC from "1912"; for years of the ROC era, add the ROC year to "1911". For example, 5 years before the ROC is AD 1907, and ROC year 5 is AD 1916. Year Month Day Use a 4-digit AD year 01 January 01 9999 Year unknown 02 February 02 03 March 03 … … … … 10 October 29 11 November 30 12 December 31 99 Month unknown 99 Day unknown Examples: Code: Case
19060630: The case's date of birth is June 30, 6 years before the ROC.
19409999: The case was 60 years old on June 15, ROC year 89 (2000), and the medical record does not document the date of birth. Record the month and day as unknown (99 and 99 respectively), and the birth year is calculated as ROC year 29 (1940).
19279999: The medical record only documents the case's birth year as ROC year 16 (1927).

fields.description_zh: 記錄個案在診斷為癌症時之戶籍地代碼。
fields.description_en: Records the registered household address code of the case at the time of cancer diagnosis.
fields.purpose_zh: 為個案流行病學之地域資料，並可作為癌症群聚或環境因素研究分析。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄身分證上戶籍地址之鄉鎮市區代碼，依附錄A「戶籍地代碼表」填入。
• 病歷上若有二個(含)以上地址時，應予以詳細查明，勿任意填選。癌症確認
fields.purpose_en: Epidemiological geographic data on the case, which can be used for analysis of cancer clusters or environmental factors.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the township/district code of the registered household address on the identity card, filled in according to Appendix A “Registered household address code table”.
• If the medical record has two or more addresses, find out the details carefully and do not choose arbitrarily. Cancer confirmation

fields.description_zh: 記錄個案診斷此癌症時之實足年齡。
fields.description_en: Records the case's age in completed years at the diagnosis of this cancer.
fields.purpose_zh: 有助於個案的確認，且對於統計分析癌症相關資料時，年齡常是一個重要的因素。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案診斷為此癌症時的實足年齡。
• 若個案有多個原發癌症，診斷年齡應該依不同原發而個別計算。
• 若個案於2010年1月1日(含)之後在子宮內即被診斷為癌症者(in utero diagnosis)，診斷年齡為000。
fields.purpose_en: Helps identify the case, and age is often an important factor in statistical analysis of cancer-related data.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the patient's age in completed years at the time of diagnosis of this cancer.
• If the patient has multiple primary cancers, the age at diagnosis should be calculated separately for each primary.
• If a patient was diagnosed with cancer in utero (in utero diagnosis) on or after 1 January 2010, the age at diagnosis is 000.

fields.description_zh: 指個案一生中所罹患惡性腫瘤的發生順序。
fields.description_en: Refers to the order of occurrence of malignant tumors in the case's lifetime.
fields.purpose_zh: 可用來選擇單一原發腫瘤個案及進行特定的追蹤研究，並可分析發生多發腫瘤的因子。
fields.guide_zh:
• 編碼01代表個案的第1個惡性腫瘤，而後續腫瘤的譯碼數字則依序類推。
• 如果同時診斷出2個或2個以上的惡性腫瘤或原位癌時，則預後最差的診斷給予最低順序的號碼。若其預後沒有差異性，則順序號碼的決定就沒有硬性規定。
• 若申報醫院在稍後得知有尚未登錄的腫瘤且會影響到腫瘤發生的順序，則應該要再重新編腫瘤發生順序號碼。範例：編碼：案例
01：個案以前並無癌症病史，在民國92年6 月13日診斷出有乳房原位癌。
02：個案在民國 92 年 6 月 13 日診斷為乳癌，之後在民國 92 年 8 月 30 日診斷為皮膚黑色素瘤之癌症發生順序號碼。
fields.purpose_en: Can be used to select single-primary-tumor cases for specific follow-up studies, and to analyze factors in the occurrence of multiple tumors.
fields.guide_en:
• Code 01 represents the case's first malignant tumor, and the code numbers of subsequent tumors follow in sequence.
• If 2 or more malignant tumors or carcinomas in situ are diagnosed at the same time, the diagnosis with the worst prognosis is given the lowest sequence number. If there is no difference in prognosis, there is no fixed rule for determining the sequence numbers.
• If the reporting hospital later learns of an unregistered tumor that affects the order of tumor occurrence, the tumor sequence numbers should be reassigned. Examples: Code: Case
01: The case had no previous history of cancer and was diagnosed with breast carcinoma in situ on June 13, ROC year 92 (2003).
02: The case was diagnosed with breast cancer on June 13, ROC year 92 (2003) and then diagnosed with the cancer of cutaneous melanoma on August 30, ROC year 92 (2003); this is its sequence number.

fields.description_zh: 將個案進行分類。
fields.description_en: Classifies the case.
fields.purpose_zh: 在做治療和存活分析時，本欄位將個案分為可分析和不可分析個案兩類。進而提供申報醫院進行研究個案之選擇。
fields.guide_zh:
• 個案分類包括0、1、2、3、5、7、8、9共8類。可分析治療和存活的個案編碼為1-2；不可分析個案編碼為0，3-9。
• 癌症診療臨床情境可以非常錯綜複雜，癌症登記師在申報個案資料時，必須參考在規定申報期限內所有相關的病歷資料，以完成正確個案分類。
• 個案分類的編碼必須經由綜合判斷「2.3.1診斷狀態分類 」及「2.3.2治療狀態分類」兩個新欄位的編碼，方能正確的摘錄。
• Class 1 及 Class 2 個案必須詳細申報所有項目。
• Class 0 個案不需申報欄位序號#7.1~7.10，以”9”補滿。
• Class 3 個案不需申報欄位序號#7.1~7.10，以”9”補滿。
• 於申報醫院診斷並於申報醫院訂定首次療程為不予治療的個案，個案分類編碼是1，不可編碼為0。
• 雙碼分類為12、15、16、19的Class 0個案，必須是在申報期限內，確實未於申報醫院接受任何治療，方能以上述分類申報。
• Class 0中雙碼分類為12的個案，申報醫院必須確認個案接受後續診療的醫院，方能以雙碼12申報此個案。
• 可分析個案Analytic case :雙碼11、13、14個案(class 1)及21、23、24個案(class 2)。
• 不可分析個案Non-analytic case: 雙碼10、12、15、16、19個案 (class 0) 及雙碼20、22、25、26、27、29、30、32、34、35、36、37、39個案 (class 3)
• 不需申報個案: 個案分類為編碼 7、8 者，不需申報。
• 於他院診斷，但為了其他疾病至申報醫院求診之個案，不需申報。
• 首次療程與後續治療定義請詳見總論說明。
• 根據「2.3.1診斷狀態分類 」及「2.3.2治療狀態分類」綜合判斷「2.3個案分類 」：範例：個案：診斷 治療分類：狀態 狀態案例編碼：分類 分類編碼：編碼
0：1 0 個案因暈眩、跌倒而到申報醫院，做腦部電腦斷層及核磁共振造影檢查，結果發現腦部的雙葉有多重性轉移情形，肺部電腦斷層發現右上肺葉有 4公分腫塊且縱膈腔及肺門處有淋巴結病變，診斷為肺癌併腦部轉移。個案因病情急速惡化，未能接受任何治療即死亡。
0：1 2 個案因暈眩、跌倒而到申報醫院，做腦部電腦斷層及核磁共振造影檢查，結果發現腦部的雙葉有多重性轉移情形，肺部電腦斷層發現右上肺葉有 4公分腫塊且縱膈腔及肺門處有淋巴結病變，診斷為肺癌併腦部轉移。個案自動出院，申報醫院僅獲知個案已自行前往 B 醫院，但申報醫院未能得知個案在 B 醫院的診療詳情。
0：1 5 個案因暈眩、跌倒而到申報醫院，做腦部電腦斷層及核磁共振造影檢查，結果發現腦部的雙葉有多重性轉移情形，肺部電腦斷層發現右上肺葉有 4公分腫塊且縱膈腔及肺門處有淋巴結病變，診斷為肺癌併腦部轉移。個案未接受進一步治療即出院，後續追蹤獲知個案服用中草藥治療肺癌。
0：1 5 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，個案起初拒絕手術而服用中草藥治療肺癌；個案於最初診斷日第三個月，惡化為臨床期別第三期時，才開始接受放射治療。
0：1 6 個案因陰道不正常出血至申報醫院檢查，經子宮內膜刮除(D & C)切片證實為子宮內膜癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，但個案拒絕；於最初診斷日一年後，個案回診並重新評估臨床期別仍為第一期，且接受手術切除。
0：1 6 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，但個案未接受該治療；個案於最初診斷日第五個月，惡化為臨床期別第三期時，才開始接受放射治療。
0：1 6 個案因暈眩、跌倒而到申報醫院，做腦部電腦斷層及核磁共振造影檢查，結果發現腦部的雙葉有多重性轉移情形，肺部電腦斷層發現右上肺葉有 4公分腫塊且縱膈腔及肺門處有淋巴結病變，診斷為肺癌併腦部轉移。個案未接受進一步治療即出院，並拒絕追蹤。
0：1 9 個案因乳房腫塊，到申報醫院接受切片證實為原發性乳癌，但個案失聯且無法追蹤。個案：診斷 治療分類：狀態 狀態案例編碼：分類 分類編碼：編碼
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，且在申報醫院接受手術及放射治療。
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，但因為充血性心衰竭治療，個案於最初診斷日第五個月後，才接受手術切除仍為臨床期別第一期的肺癌。
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，個案起初拒絕手術而服用中草藥治療肺癌；於最初診斷日第五個月後，重新評估臨床期別仍為第一期，並接受手術切除。
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，但個案猶豫不決；個案於最初診斷日第五個月後，重新評估臨床期別仍為第一期，並同意接受手術切除。
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，個案未接受；於最初診斷日六個月後，重新評估臨床期別仍為第一期，並進行放射治療。
1：1 1 個案因腹痛至申報醫院，腹部超音波發現個案脾臟腫大且抽血發現紅血球過高，再經由 JAK2 檢驗被醫師診斷為真性多紅血球症(Polycythemia vera，PV)；為使紅血球數降低個案在申報醫院接受放血治療(phlebotomy)，且因合併脾臟腫大接受口服化學治療。
1：1 1 個案因貧血而到申報醫院，經由抽血、骨髓切片檢查被醫師診斷為Acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL)，在申報醫院先接受Retinoid acid (ATRA） 及類固醇藥物再進行化療治療。
1：1 1 口腔癌第三期個案接受 Cisplatin 合併免疫治療雙盲臨床試驗Nimotuzumab or Placebo。
1：1 3 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期並接受手術治療(病理期別第三期)。後個案轉至外院接受輔助化學藥物治療後，才於最初診斷日第七個月時，再回至申報醫院接受輔助放射治療。

fields.purpose_en: For treatment and survival analysis, this field classifies cases as analytic or non-analytic, thereby helping the reporting hospital select cases for research.
fields.guide_en:
• Case classes comprise 8 categories: 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8 and 9. Cases analyzable for treatment and survival are coded 1-2; non-analytic cases are coded 0 and 3-9.
• Clinical scenarios in cancer care can be very complex. When reporting case data, the cancer registrar must consult all relevant medical records within the prescribed reporting period in order to assign the correct case class.
• The case class code must be abstracted by jointly considering the codes of the two new fields "2.3.1 Diagnostic status class" and "2.3.2 Treatment status class".
• Class 1 and Class 2 cases must have all items reported in detail.
• For Class 0 cases, field serial numbers #7.1~#7.10 need not be reported and are filled with "9".
• For Class 3 cases, field serial numbers #7.1~#7.10 need not be reported and are filled with "9".
• A case diagnosed at the reporting hospital for which the reporting hospital determined that the first course of treatment is no treatment is coded case class 1 and must not be coded 0.
• Class 0 cases with two-digit class 12, 15, 16 or 19 may be reported under these classes only if the case definitely received no treatment at the reporting hospital within the reporting period.
• For a Class 0 case with two-digit class 12, the reporting hospital must confirm the hospital where the case received subsequent care before the case can be reported as two-digit 12.
• Analytic cases: two-digit 11, 13, 14 (class 1) and 21, 23, 24 (class 2).
• Non-analytic cases: two-digit 10, 12, 15, 16, 19 (class 0) and two-digit 20, 22, 25, 26, 27, 29, 30, 32, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39 (class 3)
• Cases not required to be reported: cases with case class code 7 or 8 need not be reported.
• Cases diagnosed at another facility who visit the reporting hospital for other diseases need not be reported.
• For definitions of first course of treatment and subsequent treatment, see the general introduction.
• Determine "2.3 Case class" by jointly considering "2.3.1 Diagnostic status class" and "2.3.2 Treatment status class". Examples: Case: Diagnosis: Treatment: Class: Status: Status: Case code: Class: Class code: Code

fields.description_zh: 記錄個案至申報醫院首次為此癌症就診時的癌症診療情境。
fields.description_en: Records the clinical setting of cancer care when the case first visited the reporting hospital for this cancer.
fields.purpose_zh: 與新增欄位2.3.2「治療狀態分類」並用，以確保欄位 2.3「個案分類」的正確性。
fields.guide_zh:
• 病歷上僅有症狀敘述不能視為癌症診斷。
• 病歷上若未描述個案是否已在他院診斷，而醫師依據本院檢查報告或臨床方法確診，則視為本院診斷。
• 診斷狀態分類編碼為7、8之個案不需申報。範例：
• 詳見2.3「個案分類」編碼案例
fields.purpose_en: Used together with the newly added field 2.3.2 "Treatment status category" to ensure the accuracy of field 2.3 "Case category".
fields.guide_en:
• A description of symptoms alone in the medical record cannot be regarded as a cancer diagnosis.
• If the medical record does not describe whether the case was already diagnosed at another facility, and the physician confirms the diagnosis based on this hospital's examination reports or clinical methods, it is regarded as diagnosed at this hospital.
• Cases with a diagnostic status classification code of 7 or 8 do not need to be reported. Example:
• See the 2.3 “Case class” coding cases

fields.description_zh: 記錄此個案在申報時的治療狀態。
fields.description_en: Records the treatment status of this case at the time of reporting.
fields.purpose_zh: 與新增欄位2.3.1「診斷狀態分類」並用，以確保欄位2.3「個案分類」的正確性。此欄位並協助記錄個案未於申報醫院接受首次療程的原因，以協助申報醫院改善管理個案流失；並提供此數據作為公衛行政資源調整的依據。
fields.guide_zh:
• 如果病歷中沒有治療計畫、也沒有制定好的治療或處置指引可供參考，同時無法諮詢到主責醫師時，請參考以下原則：「首次療程必須起始於最初診斷日期的四個月之內」。
• 治療狀態分類編碼2(他院診療)、5(接受另類療法)、6 (拒絕治療)、9(失聯或首次療程不詳)的優先順序依次為2、5、6、9。
• 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，視為申報醫院接受部分首次療程，也於他院接受部分首次療程，編碼為113。
• 申報醫院若僅被委託執行部分放射治療，則視為申報醫院沒有執行首次療程，應編碼為322。
• 治療狀態分類編碼4為醫師決定不予以治療、再密切觀察(Watchful observation)、僅給予非腫瘤切除之緩和性手術、疼痛控制(pain control)、支持療法(supportive care)或轉介安寧照護。例如：若攝護腺癌個案僅接受TURP，後續醫生選擇積極監測(Active surveillance)或予以密切觀察(Watchful waiting)，「治療狀態分類」編碼為4。
• 若個案僅接受其他治療，其「治療狀態分類」欄位應編碼為1，下列處置為「治療狀態分類」欄位所定義之其他治療： UV therapy (ultraviolet) for skin cancer or cutaneous lymphoma. Trichloroacetic acid for anal intraepithelial neoplasia, grade III (AIN III) ONLY. Antibiotics/anti-microbials/anti-viral agents, such as anti-helicobacter pylori for gastric MALT lymphoma ONLY. Retinoid acid (ATRA) for acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) ONLY. Anagrelide HCl for Essential thrombocythemia ONLY. Phlebotomy for polycythemia vera ONLY. Blood-thinners and/or anti-clotting agents for essential thrombocythemia (9962/3) ONLY 非肝癌個案執行TAE治療。注意: 其他治療若後續有新增處置，將以SEER 網站上之藥物查詢工具為依據:
http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx/。 檢索藥物時，若藥劑類別(category)顯示為 Other therapy 時，則視為其他治療。 藥劑類別若已清楚明示 (e.g. chemotherapy)，則將該藥物摘錄至適當治療欄位。 若無法在SEER*Rx 查詢到之藥物，請勿直接摘錄為其他治療，應先諮詢主責醫師。
• 根據Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manua第24頁，"輸血"不視為癌症治療，而是症狀緩解，故「治療狀態分類」欄位應編碼為4。Do not collect blood transfusions (whole blood, platelets, etc.) as treatment. Blood transfusions are used widely to treat anemia and it is not possible to collect this procedure in a meaningful way.
• 「治療狀態分類」欄位編碼4與6之釐清： 若個案拒絕醫師或臨床指引建議之首次治療，但接受非腫瘤切除之緩和性手術、疼痛控制、支持療法、轉介安寧照護或其他治療者，其「治療狀態分類」欄位應編碼為4。 若個案拒絕醫師或臨床指引建議之首次治療，且未接受非腫瘤切除之緩和性手術、疼痛控制、支持療法、轉介安寧照護或其他治療者，其「治療狀態分類」欄位應編碼為6。
• 治療狀態分類編碼5中所指的另類治療為本手冊未規範定義之各種療法，而且個案自行認定該療法對癌症有療效的治療。這些另類療法包括，但不僅限定於中草藥、氣功、生機療法及個案在未參與癌症診療認證合格的診所或醫療機構所接受被宣稱具有療效的免疫療法。
• 治療狀態分類編碼7(他院診療)必須伴隨診斷狀況分類碼為2或3。範例：
• 詳見2.3「個案分類」編碼案例
fields.purpose_en: Used together with the new field 2.3.1 'Diagnostic status category' to ensure the correctness of field 2.3 'Case category'. This field also helps record the reasons why the case did not receive the first course at the reporting hospital, to help the reporting hospital improve management of case loss, and provides these data as a basis for adjusting public health administrative resources.
fields.guide_en:
• If the medical record has no treatment plan and no established treatment or management guideline for reference, and the attending physician cannot be consulted, use the following principle: "the first course of treatment must start within four months of the date of initial diagnosis".
• The order of priority of treatment status class codes 2 (care at another facility), 5 (alternative therapy received), 6 (treatment refused) and 9 (lost to contact or first course of treatment unknown) is 2, 5, 6, 9.
• If the reporting hospital commissioned another facility to perform part of the radiotherapy, this is regarded as the case receiving part of the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital and part of the first course of treatment at another facility; code 113.
• If the reporting hospital was only commissioned to perform part of the radiotherapy, it is regarded as the reporting hospital not having performed the first course of treatment; code 322.
• Treatment status class code 4 is for: the physician decides not to treat, watchful observation, only palliative surgery that does not resect the tumor, pain control, supportive care, or referral to hospice care. For example: if a prostate cancer case receives only TURP and the physician subsequently chooses active surveillance or watchful waiting, code "Treatment status class" as 4.
• If the case receives only other therapy, code the "Treatment status class" field as 1. The following procedures are defined as other therapy for the "Treatment status class" field: UV therapy (ultraviolet) for skin cancer or cutaneous lymphoma. Trichloroacetic acid for anal intraepithelial neoplasia, grade III (AIN III) ONLY. Antibiotics/anti-microbials/anti-viral agents, such as anti-helicobacter pylori for gastric MALT lymphoma ONLY. Retinoid acid (ATRA) for acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) ONLY. Anagrelide HCl for Essential thrombocythemia ONLY. Phlebotomy for polycythemia vera ONLY. Blood-thinners and/or anti-clotting agents for essential thrombocythemia (9962/3) ONLY. TAE performed in a non-liver cancer case. Note: if procedures are later added to other therapy, the drug lookup tool on the SEER website will be used as the basis:
http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx/. When searching for a drug, if the category is shown as Other therapy, it is regarded as other therapy. If the category is clearly stated (e.g. chemotherapy), abstract the drug into the appropriate treatment field. If a drug cannot be found in SEER*Rx, do not directly abstract it as other therapy; consult the attending physician first.
• According to page 24 of the Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual, "blood transfusion" is not regarded as cancer treatment but as symptom relief, so the "Treatment status class" field should be coded 4. Do not collect blood transfusions (whole blood, platelets, etc.) as treatment. Blood transfusions are used widely to treat anemia and it is not possible to collect this procedure in a meaningful way.
• Clarification of codes 4 and 6 of the "Treatment status class" field: if the case refuses the first treatment recommended by the physician or clinical guideline but receives palliative surgery that does not resect the tumor, pain control, supportive care, referral to hospice care or other therapy, code the "Treatment status class" field as 4. If the case refuses the first treatment recommended by the physician or clinical guideline and does not receive palliative surgery that does not resect the tumor, pain control, supportive care, referral to hospice care or other therapy, code the "Treatment status class" field as 6.
• Alternative therapy referred to in treatment status class code 5 means various therapies not defined in this manual that the case himself/herself regards as effective against cancer. These alternative therapies include, but are not limited to, Chinese herbal medicine, qigong, biological/natural therapy, and immunotherapy claimed to be effective received at clinics or medical institutions not accredited for cancer care.
• Treatment status class code 7 (care at another facility) must be accompanied by diagnostic status class code 2 or 3. Examples:
• For details see the case examples in 2.3 "Case class" coding

fields.description_zh: 個案因此癌症至申報醫院門診或住院之最早日期。
fields.description_en: Earliest date the case visited the outpatient clinic or was hospitalized at the reporting hospital for this cancer.
fields.purpose_zh: 可用來計算個案首次就診至進行癌症登記之時間間隔；也可用來計算首次就診至治療之時間差距，以作為監控癌症照護品質之用。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案因此癌症至申報醫院門診或住院之最早日期。
• 本欄位可以是個案於門診作切片檢查、放射線檢查、實驗室檢查的日期。
• 若個案由屍體解剖時才診斷為癌症(個案分類為5)或僅由死亡證明書診斷為癌症(個案分類為8)，則以死亡日期作為首次就診日期。範例：編碼：案例
20040212：個案於民國93年2月12日在申報醫院門診接受乳房攝影檢查結果懷疑是惡性，之後於民國 93年2月14日作切除性切片檢查(excisional biopsy)或根除性手術。則乳房攝影的日期(民國93年2月12 日)即為個案之首次就診日期。
20030914：個案於民國 92年9月8日在私人診所中作切片檢查，其病理標本送至申報醫院判讀為惡性黑色素瘤。個案於民國 92 年 9 月 14 日在申報醫院進行廣泛性再切除手術。
20041207：個案因嚴重頭痛和失去方向感等症狀，於民國 93 年 12 月 7 日接受腦部磁振造影檢查懷疑是星狀細胞瘤，於民國 93年12月19日接受手術切除全部的腫瘤。
20050999：住進申報醫院的確切日期不詳，只知道是民國 94年9月。
fields.purpose_en: Can be used to calculate the interval from the case's first visit to cancer registration; can also be used to calculate the interval from first visit to treatment, for monitoring the quality of cancer care.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the earliest date on which the case visited the reporting hospital outpatient clinic or was admitted for this cancer.
• This field may be the date of an outpatient biopsy, radiologic examination or laboratory test of the case.
• If the case was diagnosed with cancer only at autopsy (case class 5) or only by the death certificate (case class 8), use the date of death as the date of first visit. Examples: Code: Case
20040212: The case had a mammogram at the reporting hospital outpatient clinic on February 12, ROC year 93 (2004), with a result suspicious for malignancy, and then underwent excisional biopsy or radical surgery on February 14, ROC year 93 (2004). The date of the mammogram (February 12, ROC year 93 (2004)) is the case's date of first visit.
20030914: The case had a biopsy at a private clinic on September 8, ROC year 92 (2003), and the pathology specimen was sent to the reporting hospital and read as malignant melanoma. The case underwent wide re-excision at the reporting hospital on September 14, ROC year 92 (2003).
20041207: The case, with severe headache and disorientation, had brain MRI on December 7, ROC year 93 (2004) suspicious for astrocytoma, and underwent surgical resection of the entire tumor on December 19, ROC year 93 (2004).
20050999: The exact date of admission to the reporting hospital is unknown; only the month, September ROC year 94 (2005), is known.

fields.description_zh: 記錄此癌症最早被醫師診斷的日期。
fields.description_en: Records the date this cancer was first diagnosed by a physician.
fields.purpose_zh: 可計算癌症最初診斷日期至完成分期或開始治療的時間間隔。
fields.guide_zh:
• 最初診斷日期可以是臨床或病理上診斷為癌症的開始日期。亦即「個案在申報醫院或外院被醫師診斷為癌症(或疑似癌症)的第一天」。需注意本欄位日期一定小於或等於「最後聯絡或死亡日期」。
• 若細胞學檢查(cytology)報告中使用含糊不清的詞彙，例如”suspicious for malignancy”只有在切片檢查為陽性或醫師有臨床判斷並支持此細胞學檢查時，才可編碼為最初診斷日期。
• 若僅是異常腫瘤指標不可視為癌症確診方式，需採用臨床判斷、病理或細胞學檢查確認陽性的日期，才可作為最初診斷日期，不可回推至該腫瘤指標採檢日為最初診斷日期。例如︰個案PSA值升高，但理學檢查為陰性。醫生建議個案接受攝護腺細針切片( fine needle biopsy)，病理報告結果為adenocarcinoma；則最初診斷日期應為切片日期(不可將PSA報告日或是採檢日作為最初診斷日期)。例如︰個案PSA值升高，但理學檢查為陰性。醫生於病歷上描述懷疑病人有攝護腺癌並建議個案接受攝護腺細針切片，切片結果為陽性，證實醫生的懷疑；則最初診斷日期應摘錄醫生描述懷疑為攝護腺癌的日期。注意︰僅有異常腫瘤指標不可視為癌症最初診斷日期。
• 個案經診斷為白血病或其他血液腫瘤疾患(排除淋巴癌)者： 疑似癌症的日期不可摘錄為最初診斷日期。 注意：白血病個案若周邊血液(peripheral blood) blast≧20%，雖然醫師於病歷描述為rule out leukemia，仍可視為確診。 僅單次全血球計數(CBC)或白血球計數(WBC)報告確診，或多份報告但醫師明示依據某份報告診斷為癌症，則以該次採檢日為最初診斷日期。 有多次不足以確診之全血球計數或白血球計數報告時，醫師亦未明示依據某份報告診斷為癌症，則採用醫師診斷為癌症的日期作為最初診斷日期。 若全血球計數或白血球計數報告不足以確診為癌症，且醫師亦未確診癌症，經骨髓或其他切片檢查結果確診為癌症時，則以病理採檢日期為最初診斷日期。 若病理或細胞學報告均無法判斷為癌症時，以醫師診斷為癌症的日期為最初診斷日期。
• 個案在確定診斷之前就已接受首次療程，若無最初診斷日期，則可以治療開始的日期作為最初診斷日期。
• 有關作為癌症診斷的用語，可參考第一部份的「含糊不清詞彙」表列的內容。
• 個案分類為5者，其最初診斷日期即為死亡日期。
• 若個案於2010年1月1日(含)之後在子宮內即被診斷為癌症者(in utero diagnosis)，其最初診斷日期請填正確診斷或接受治療的日期；若是2010年以前之個案，則最初診斷日期請填出生日期。
• 若個案曾在外院診斷為癌症而日期不詳者，儘可能推算至月份；月份不詳者，請依下列原則編碼： 年度、季節可推算，但月份無法推算：年度依推算編碼；月份依季節編碼，春季為0499、夏季為0799、秋季為1099、冬季為1299(年尾)或0199(年初)。若診斷月份無法推算，則編碼為9999。 若院外最初診斷日期年、月、日皆不詳，則不須申報。範例：編碼：案例
20050312：民國 94 年 3 月 12 日的乳房攝影檢查顯示，個案右邊乳房的外上四分之一處有癌症(compatible with carcinoma)。民國94年 3月20日個案接受乳房切除性切片檢查確診為浸潤性管道癌(infiltrating ductal carcinoma)。
20030512：醫師記載個案在民國 92 年 5 月 12 日體檢時發現攝護腺有結節且懷疑是癌症。民國 92 年 6 月 15 日做攝護腺超音波導引的細針切片檢查(ultrasound guided needle biopsy)，結果確診為腺癌(adenocarcinoma)。
20040199：個案於民國 93 年 1 月因子宮內膜異位(endometriosis)而接受經腹部全子宮切除術(total abdominal hysterectomy)。於民國 94 年11月因腹痛、腹脹而住院，經腹腔鏡行網膜切片檢查(laparoscopy with omental biopsy)結果顯示為轉移性囊狀腺癌(metastatic cystadenocarcinoma)。病理醫師重新調閱民國 93 年子宮切除的標本，確認在左側卵巢有囊狀腺癌。
20059999：若最初診斷的確切日期不詳，則記錄其約略的日期，例如只知道是民國 94年。
20110904：個案於民國 100年 9 月1日進行 CBC/WBC 檢查，醫師於 9月 3日依據細胞學報告結果下診斷為 R/O 白血病。民國 100 年 9 月 4 日再經骨髓切片之histology 結果確診為AML。
20110903：個案於民國 100 年 9 月 1 日進行 CBC/WBC 檢查且 blasts=18%，醫師未下診斷為癌症或疑似癌症，民國100年 9月3日再經骨髓切片之histology結果確診為AML。
20110902：個案於民國 100 年9月 1 日進行 CBC/WBC 檢查，結果有疑異，民國 100 年9 月 2 日再經抽血進行免疫表現分型檢查，醫師於民國 100 年 9 月 5 日依據免疫表現分型報告判斷為 AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22)。
20110901：個案於民國 100 年9月 1 日進行 CBC/WBC 檢查，結果有疑異，醫師將 9 月1 日的血液樣本，於 9 月 2 日申請對該異常檢體進行免疫表現分型檢查，醫師於民國 100 年 9 月 5 日依據免疫表現分型報告判斷為 AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22)。
20110904：個案於民國 100年9月1日進行 CBC/WBC檢查，醫師於 9月3日依據細胞學報告結果下診斷為 R/O 白血病。民國100年9月4日開始化學治療。
fields.purpose_en: Allows calculation of the time interval from the initial cancer diagnosis date to completion of staging or start of treatment.
fields.guide_en:
• The date of initial diagnosis may be the date on which cancer was first diagnosed clinically or pathologically, i.e. "the first day on which the case was diagnosed with cancer (or suspected cancer) by a physician at the reporting hospital or another facility". Note that this date must be earlier than or equal to the "date of last contact or death".
• If a cytology report uses ambiguous terms such as "suspicious for malignancy", the date may be coded as the date of initial diagnosis only if a biopsy is positive or the physician made a clinical judgment supporting the cytology result.
• Abnormal tumor markers alone cannot be regarded as confirmation of cancer; the date must be the date of clinical judgment, or of positive pathology or cytology confirmation, and it must not be backdated to the tumor marker sampling date as the date of initial diagnosis. Example: a case had an elevated PSA but a negative physical examination. The physician recommended a prostate fine needle biopsy, and the pathology report was adenocarcinoma; the date of initial diagnosis should be the biopsy date (do not use the PSA report date or sampling date as the date of initial diagnosis). Example: a case had an elevated PSA but a negative physical examination. The physician described in the medical record a suspicion of prostate cancer and recommended a prostate fine needle biopsy; the biopsy was positive, confirming the physician's suspicion; the date of initial diagnosis should be abstracted as the date on which the physician described suspected prostate cancer. Note: abnormal tumor markers alone cannot be regarded as the date of initial cancer diagnosis.
• For a case diagnosed with leukemia or another hematologic disorder (excluding lymphoma): The date of suspected cancer must not be abstracted as the date of initial diagnosis. Note: for a leukemia case, if the peripheral blood blast is ≧20%, even if the physician described rule out leukemia in the medical record, it can still be regarded as confirmed. If a single complete blood count (CBC) or white blood cell count (WBC) report confirms the diagnosis, or there are multiple reports but the physician explicitly states that the cancer diagnosis was based on a particular report, the sampling date of that report is the date of initial diagnosis. If there are multiple CBC or WBC reports that are insufficient for confirmation and the physician did not explicitly state which report the cancer diagnosis was based on, use the date on which the physician diagnosed cancer as the date of initial diagnosis. If the CBC or WBC reports are insufficient to confirm cancer and the physician did not diagnose cancer, and cancer is confirmed by bone marrow or other biopsy results, use the pathology sampling date as the date of initial diagnosis. If neither pathology nor cytology reports can establish cancer, use the date on which the physician diagnosed cancer as the date of initial diagnosis.
• If the case received the first course of treatment before the diagnosis was established and there is no date of initial diagnosis, the date treatment started may be used as the date of initial diagnosis.
• For the terms used in diagnosing cancer, refer to the table of "ambiguous terms" in Part 1.
• For cases with class of case 5, the date of initial diagnosis is the date of death.
• If a case was diagnosed with cancer in utero (in utero diagnosis) on or after January 1, 2010, enter the date of the correct diagnosis or of receiving treatment as the date of initial diagnosis; for cases before 2010, enter the date of birth as the date of initial diagnosis.
• If a case was diagnosed with cancer at another facility with an unknown date, estimate it as far as the month if possible; if the month is unknown, code according to the following rules: If the year and season can be estimated but not the month: code the year as estimated; code the month by season: spring 0499, summer 0799, autumn 1099, winter 1299 (end of the year) or 0199 (beginning of the year). If the month of diagnosis cannot be estimated, code 9999. If the year, month and day of the initial diagnosis outside the facility are all unknown, no report is needed. Examples: Code: Case
20050312: A mammography on March 12, ROC year 94 (2005) showed cancer in the upper outer quadrant of the right breast (compatible with carcinoma). On March 20, ROC year 94 (2005), the case underwent an excisional breast biopsy that confirmed infiltrating ductal carcinoma.
20030512: The physician recorded that on May 12, ROC year 92 (2003), a physical examination found a prostate nodule suspicious for cancer. On June 15, ROC year 92 (2003), an ultrasound-guided needle biopsy of the prostate confirmed adenocarcinoma.
20040199: In January, ROC year 93 (2004), the case underwent total abdominal hysterectomy for endometriosis. In November, ROC year 94 (2005), the case was hospitalized for abdominal pain and distension, and laparoscopy with omental biopsy showed metastatic cystadenocarcinoma. The pathologist re-examined the ROC year 93 (2004) hysterectomy specimen and confirmed cystadenocarcinoma in the left ovary.
20059999: If the exact date of initial diagnosis is unknown, record the approximate date, e.g. only the ROC year 94 (2005) is known.
20110904: The case had a CBC/WBC test on September 1, ROC year 100 (2011); on September 3 the physician diagnosed R/O leukemia based on the cytology report. On September 4, ROC year 100 (2011), the histology of a bone marrow biopsy confirmed AML.
20110903: The case had a CBC/WBC test on September 1, ROC year 100 (2011) with blasts=18%; the physician did not diagnose cancer or suspected cancer; on September 3, ROC year 100 (2011), the histology of a bone marrow biopsy confirmed AML.
20110902: The case had a CBC/WBC test on September 1, ROC year 100 (2011) with a questionable result; on September 2, ROC year 100 (2011), a blood draw was taken for immunophenotyping, and on September 5, ROC year 100 (2011), the physician judged AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22) based on the immunophenotyping report.
20110901: The case had a CBC/WBC test on September 1, ROC year 100 (2011) with a questionable result; the physician requested immunophenotyping on the September 1 blood sample on September 2 for that abnormal specimen, and on September 5, ROC year 100 (2011), judged AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22) based on the immunophenotyping report.
20110904: The case had a CBC/WBC test on September 1, ROC year 100 (2011); on September 3 the physician diagnosed R/O leukemia based on the cytology report. Chemotherapy started on September 4, ROC year 100 (2011).

fields.description_zh: 確認癌症原發部位。
fields.description_en: Confirms the primary site of the cancer.
fields.purpose_zh: 原發部位是分期及決定治療方針之依據；同時也影響其預後及病程。
fields.guide_zh:
 依ICD-O-3腫瘤部位碼(topography code)進行原發部位編碼。腫瘤部位碼是以大寫字母C開頭，之後加上3個數字碼(不記錄小數點)，編碼範圍為C000-C809 (”C”為大寫)，第4位盡量查明詳填，實在無法辨識才能填9。實體腫瘤原發部位編碼可參考的資源(按優先順序排列)： ICD-O (國際腫瘤疾病分類)。 SEER手冊 (Including Coding Guidelines in Appendix C )。
https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/codingmanuals/ Solid Tumor Rules (實體腫瘤編碼規則)。 若病歷紀錄並無原發部位之相關資訊，可詢問主責醫師以確認其原發部位或最確切之部位碼。一般來說，外科醫師通常比病理醫師更能準確判斷腫瘤的原發部位。因外科醫師能直接看到腫瘤在手術位置中的情況，而病理醫師通常是根據外科醫師提供的資訊，並觀察從原始位置取出的標本。然而，若病理醫師觀察的是整個器官(如胰臟)，也可能精確指出該器官內的原發部位。 例如，在胰臟切除術(pancreatectomy)中，若外科醫師記錄原發部位為胰臟體部(pancreas body)，而病理報告則記載為胰臟頸部(pancreas neck)，此時可能出現判定差異。需注意的是，頸部為胰臟中一狹窄區段，位於頭部與體部之間；臨床上對於腫瘤位於體部或頸部的判斷，有時可能因解剖定位或主觀認知而異。在此例中，原發部位應優先依據外科醫師判斷，並將其編碼為胰臟體部(C251)。實質腫瘤編碼原則：
• 應參考病歷中所有可獲得的資訊以編碼原發部位，除非另有說明。
• 原發部位應編碼為腫瘤最初發生的位置(site of origin)，即使腫瘤已擴及鄰近區域或次部位，仍應以起源部位為準。
• 原發部位的編碼應依據醫師對個案的專業判斷，反映腫瘤的起源部位。請尋找有關腫瘤最初發生位置的資訊，並一律依據腫瘤實際發生的位置進行編碼。
• 起源部位可透過以下詞語辨識，例如："tumor arose from…", "tumor originated in…", “tumor emanated from…”等相似描述。
• 原發部位(site of origin)不一定是進行切片的部位(site of biopsy)。
• 若腫瘤已擴及多個部位，仍應僅編碼其「最初起源」之部位，而非涵蓋所有侵犯或擴展之位置。例如1：最終診斷為右肺上葉腺癌。原發部位應編碼為肺上葉(C341)。例如2：個案右乳有一顆4公分的腫瘤。腫瘤起源於乳房內上象限，並延伸至內下象限。原發部位應編碼為乳房內上象限(C502)。例如3：個案有右側腮裂囊腫(branchial cleft cyst)，病理報告指出腺癌起源於腮裂囊腫內異位的甲狀腺組織。甲狀腺切除病理結果為陰性。原發部位應編碼為腮裂(C104)。例如4：個案十年前曾因非癌症因素接受全子宮切除術及雙側輸卵管卵巢切除術。現今於腹膜發現廣泛性囊腺癌(cystadenocarcinoma)。原發部位應編碼為腹膜，非特定部位(C482)。例如5：病理報告顯示為腺癌，起源於乙狀結腸上之子宮內膜異位病灶(patch of endometriosis)。原發部位應編碼為乙狀結腸(C187)。例如6：個案接受左側下唇楔形切除手術，病理顯示為侵犯性鱗狀細胞癌(invasive squamous cell carcinoma)，位於黏膜皮膚交界處(mucocutaneous junction)。手術報告與病理報告中皆無進一步資訊可支持為皮膚原發腫瘤。由於黏膜皮膚交界處與紅唇緣(vermilion border)為同義詞，且紅唇緣屬於外部下唇範圍，故原發部位應編碼為外部下唇(C001)。
• 不要為了配合分期或其他欄位資訊而調整原發部位的編碼。
• 當單一腫瘤橫跨兩個或兩個以上的細部位(subsite)，且確切起源亦不清楚時，第4碼應編碼為8。例如：病人診斷為頸胸交界段食道(cervicothoracic esophagus)的原發性腫瘤，但無法明確判定其起源點位於頸段或胸段。此原發部位應編碼為C158。注意：下列原則僅適用發生於"頭頸部"區域之皮膚癌(skin cancers overlapping sites in the head and neck)：
• 若腫瘤跨越頭頸部多個皮膚區域，應以腫瘤主要集中處(bulk of the tumor)或病灶中心點(epicenter)所在的部位作為原發部位進行編碼，勿使用C448(皮膚，跨細部位)。 若單一腫瘤同時跨越可申報部位(reportable site)與不可申報部位(non-reportable site)，依下列原則處理： 若起源部位或主要侵犯部位(size with the greatest involvement)為可申報部位，則應申報個案，並使用對應的原發部位編碼。
• 若起源部位或主要侵犯部位為不可申報部位，則不申報此個案。
• 非多重原發個案，若單一解剖部位同時包括侵襲性及原位性病灶於不同細部位，則「原發部位」應以侵襲性部份來編碼。例如1：個案左乳外上象限有侵襲性乳癌，且左乳多個象限有原位腫瘤。原發部位應編碼為乳房外上象限(C504)。例如2：個案有右側乳頭的原位Paget disease，以及右乳內下象限的浸潤性導管癌。原發部位應編碼為乳房內下象限(C503)。
• 若於同一解剖部位內出現多顆腫瘤，且分布於不同次部位(subsites)，但無法明確判定其實際起源位置，則應視為單一原發，並將該原發部位之第4碼編碼為9。例如1：個案接受膀胱經尿道切除術(TURBT)，醫師於手術中發現多發性乳突狀腫瘤分布於膀胱頸部(C675)與膀胱側壁(C672)。由於腫瘤同時位於膀胱不同區段，且無法確定實際起源部位，原發部位應編碼為膀胱，非特定部位(C679)。例如2：個案右側乳房同時發現兩顆浸潤性管道癌(infiltrating duct carcinoma)，分別位於右乳房外上象限(C504)與右乳房內下象限(C503)。原發部位應編碼為乳房，非特定部位(C509)。
• 在 ICD-O部分組織形態/性態碼(histology/behavior codes)後方，會以括號標示建議的相關原發部位編碼，例如：hepatoma (C220)。
• 當病歷上已明確記載原發部位時，應依據實際原發部位進行編碼，請忽略ICD-O所建議之部位。例如：病理報告描述為胰臟頭部(head of pancreas)之浸潤性管道癌(infiltrating duct carcinoma)。雖然在ICD-O中，浸潤性管道癌(8500/3)所建議的原發部位為乳房(C50_)，但本例中腫瘤實際發生於胰臟頭部，正確原發部位應編碼為C250 (胰臟頭部)，不得誤用建議的乳房編碼C50_。
• 若病歷記載原發部位與ICD-O建議的部位一致，或原發部位不明時，可使用ICD-O建議的原發部位代碼。例如1：切片結果顯示為肝癌(hepatoma)，但無其他原發部位資訊。依 ICD-O建議，原發部位編碼為肝臟(C220)。例如2：切除右腋下淋巴結後發現轉移性浸潤性管道癌，但右乳房為陰性。ICD-O中所述浸潤性管道癌(8500)的建議部位為乳房(C50_)。因無其他原發資訊，其原發部位應編碼為乳房，非特定部位(C509)。
• 若無任何資訊顯示腫瘤來自其他部位，則可根據ICD-O的建議使用對應的部位代碼。
• 例如：淋巴結切片診斷為非小細胞癌轉移，但尚未接受治療即過世，病歷中無其他原發部位之資訊。依據ICD-O建議，原發部位應編碼為肺(C349)。
• 若默克爾細胞癌(Merkel cell carcinoma)發生於淋巴結或遠端轉移部位，而找不到原發部位時，請將原發部位編碼為C449(皮膚，非特定部位)。
• 在缺乏任何關於原發部位的其他資訊時，請依照以下表列之原發部位/組織學代碼進行編碼。Primary Site/Histology Topography Code Ampullary/peri-ampullary C241 Anal margin C445 Anal verge C211 Angle of the stomach C162 Angular incisura of stomach C163 Back of tongue C019 Book-leaf lesion (mouth) C068 Clavicular skin C445 Colored / lipstick portion of upper lip C000 Cutaneous leiomyosarcoma C44_ Distal conus C720 Edge of tongue C021 Frontoparietal (brain) C718 Gastric angular notch (incisura) C163 Gastrohepatic ligament C481 Genu of pancreas C250 Glossotonsillar sulcus C109 Incisura, incisura angularis C163 Infrahilar area of lung C349 Interarytenoid space C329 Interhemispheric fissure (cerebrum) C710 Intracranial C719 Lateral tongue C023 Leptomeninges C709 Masticator space C760 Mastoid or mastoid complex C301 Melanoma, NOS C449 Nail bed, thumb C446 Pancreatobiliary C269 Parapharyngeal space C139 Periareolar (breast) C501 Periclitoral C511 Perihilar bile duct C240 Porta hepatis C220 Postauricular region C444 Primary Site/Histology Topography Code Preauricular (skin) C443 Prostatic sinus (urethra) C680 Pterygomandibular raphé C069 Septum pellucidum C719 Testis, descended post orchiopexy C621 True vocal folds C320 Uncinate of pancreas C250 Ureterovesical junction (UVJ) C669 應編碼腫瘤的原發部位，而非轉移部位。若確認為轉移性癌症，但無法確認原發位置，則原發部位應編碼為不明(C809)。 當病歷紀錄中缺乏足夠資訊來判定原發部位時，依下列原則編碼： 諮詢醫師，以協助指派適當的原發部位編碼。 若醫師亦無法確認原發部位，請使用該器官系統的NOS (非特定部位)分類，或使用不明確部位分類(Ill-Defined Site, C760-C768)。 頭頸部的隱匿性腫瘤(Occult Tumors of the Head and Neck)編碼原則： 若個案有第I-VII區頸部淋巴結或其他群淋巴結轉移，且淋巴結檢體以原位雜交法(in situ hybridization)檢出EBER (Epstein-Barr virus (EBV+) Encoded small RNAs)陽性，無論 p16表現狀態為何，其原發部位應編碼為鼻咽(C119)。 若個案有第I-VII區頸部淋巴結或其他群淋巴結轉移，且腫瘤為 p16陽性，其組織學顯示為與人類乳突病毒(HPV)相關口咽癌(HPV-mediated oropharyngeal carcinoma, OPC)，則原發部位應編碼為口咽(C109)。 若僅知個案頸部淋巴結陽性，無法確認原發位置，則原發部位應編碼為 C760 (頭頸部，非特定部位)。 若病歷中記載兩個或以上可能的原發部位，且都屬於同一系統(如消化系統)，請編碼為該系統的 NOS 代碼。例如：若病歷中提及可能的原發部位為結腸與小腸，則原發部位應編碼為消化道，非特定部位(C269)。 僅在醫師明確表示原發部位不明(unknown primary site)，且上述規則皆不適用時，才可編碼為「原發部位不明」(C809)。 當病歷中無足夠資訊可判定原發部位，且也無法歸類至未特定部位(NOS)或不明確部位分類(Ill-Defined Site)時，原發部位應編碼為不明(C809)。惡性肉瘤(sarcoma)編碼原則： 大多數惡性肉瘤起源於間葉組織或結締組織，這些組織分布在肌肉骨骼系統中，包括：脂肪、肌肉、血管、深層皮膚組織、神經、骨頭與軟骨。 惡性肉瘤個案若原發部位不明時，應優先編碼為 C499，而非C809。 除軟組織外，惡性肉瘤亦可能起源於空腔器官的壁層及包覆器官周圍的臟層組織(Sarcomas may also arise in the walls of hollow organs and in the viscera covering an organ.)。此時，原發部位應編碼為腫瘤起源的器官本身。例如1：病理報告診斷為子宮體carcinosarcoma，原發部位應編碼為子宮體(C549)。例如2：個案診斷為篩竇(ethmoid sinus)的橫紋肌肉瘤(rhabdomyosarcoma)，原發部位應編碼為篩竇(C311)。 當平滑肌肉瘤(leiomyosarcoma)發生於特定器官時，應將腫瘤起源器官作為原發部位進行編碼，勿編碼為軟組織。例如1：腎臟發生平滑肌肉瘤，原發部位應編碼為腎臟(C649)。例如2：攝護腺發生平滑肌肉瘤，原發部位應編碼為攝護腺(C619)。 腸胃道間質瘤(GIST)，應依據腫瘤實際起源位置進行原發部位編碼。 血管肉瘤(Angiosarcoma) 若為脾臟的血管肉瘤，原發部位應編碼為脾臟(C422)。 若為乳房的血管肉瘤，原發部位應編碼為乳房(C50_)。儘管血管肉瘤實際上起源於血管內皮細胞，但起源於乳房的血管肉瘤預後比其他乳腺腫瘤更差，因此仍應將其視為起源於乳房。移植器官(Transplants)編碼原則： 若惡性腫瘤發生在移植器官，請將原發部位編碼為該器官位置，亦即腫瘤實際存在或發生的部位。例如：若診斷為發生於移植段結腸（作為食道使用）的惡性腫瘤，則原發部位應編碼為食道。 若涉及造血或淋巴腫瘤相關移植，請參考 Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual and Database。血液惡性腫瘤及淋巴癌(Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Cancer, M9590-9993)編碼原則： 血液惡性腫瘤及淋巴癌是否為單一或多重原發，應依據 SEER Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual 最新公告版本與 The Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasms Database (Hematopoietic DB)之規則進行編碼，適用於 2010年1月1日(含)起新診斷個案。範例：編碼：案例
C108：口咽部(oropharynx)有 overlapping 的病灶。例如當有一個大腫瘤，侵犯範圍包括lateral wall of oropharynx (C10.2)和posterior wall of oropharynx(C10.3)，並且其確切起源不清楚時，第 4碼應為 8。
C678：膀胱(bladder)有重疊的病灶。例如當有一個大腫瘤，侵犯範圍包括 dome (C67.1)和lateral wall (C67.2)，並且其確切起源不清楚時，第4碼應為8。
C679：Bladder, NOS。當有多顆腫瘤起源自Bladder trigone (C67.0)和lateral wall (C67.2)時，第4碼應為 9。
C189：Colon, NOS。當患有家族性息肉症(Familial polyposis)的個案，從橫結腸(C18.4)到降結腸(C18.6)皆發生有侵襲癌和原位癌時，應記錄為一個原發癌症，部位為colon, NOS (C18.9)。詳細解說請參考第一部份多重原發之章節。
C16_：當淋巴癌位於胃(extranodal lymphoma)時，則以胃的細部位逕行編碼。
fields.purpose_en: The primary site is the basis for staging and deciding treatment policy; it also affects prognosis and disease course.
fields.guide_en:
• Code the primary site according to the ICD-O-3 topography code. The topography code begins with a capital letter C followed by 3 digits (the decimal point is not recorded); the coding range is C000-C809 ("C" must be capitalized). Identify and fill in the 4th digit whenever possible; use 9 only when it truly cannot be determined. Resources that can be consulted for coding the primary site of solid tumors (in order of priority): • ICD-O (International Classification of Diseases for Oncology). • SEER manual (Including Coding Guidelines in Appendix C ).
https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/codingmanuals/ • Solid Tumor Rules. • If the medical record contains no information on the primary site, ask the attending physician to confirm the primary site or the most precise site code. In general, surgeons can usually determine the primary site of a tumor more accurately than pathologists, because surgeons see the tumor directly in the operative field, whereas pathologists usually base their assessment on information provided by the surgeon and on the specimen removed from the original location. However, if the pathologist examines an entire organ (such as the pancreas), the primary site within that organ may also be pinpointed precisely. • For example, in a pancreatectomy, if the surgeon records the primary site as the pancreas body while the pathology report records the pancreas neck, a discrepancy may arise. Note that the neck is a narrow segment of the pancreas located between the head and the body; clinically, the judgment of whether a tumor is in the body or the neck may sometimes differ because of anatomical localization or subjective perception. In this example, the primary site should be based first on the surgeon's judgment and coded as pancreas body (C251). Coding principles for solid tumors:
• Use all available information in the medical record to code the primary site, unless otherwise specified.
• The primary site should be coded as the location where the tumor first arose (site of origin), even if the tumor has extended to adjacent areas or subsites; always use the site of origin.
• Coding of the primary site should be based on the physician's professional judgment of the case and reflect the site of origin of the tumor. Look for information on where the tumor first arose, and always code according to the location where the tumor actually arose.
• The site of origin can be identified by phrases such as "tumor arose from…", "tumor originated in…", "tumor emanated from…" and similar descriptions.
• The primary site (site of origin) is not necessarily the site of biopsy.
• If the tumor has extended to multiple sites, code only the site of "first origin", not all sites invaded or extended to. Example 1: The final diagnosis is adenocarcinoma of the right upper lobe of the lung. The primary site should be coded as upper lobe of lung (C341). Example 2: The patient has a 4 cm tumor in the right breast. The tumor arose in the upper inner quadrant of the breast and extended to the lower inner quadrant. The primary site should be coded as upper-inner quadrant of breast (C502). Example 3: The patient has a right branchial cleft cyst, and the pathology report states that adenocarcinoma arose from ectopic thyroid tissue within the branchial cleft cyst. The thyroidectomy pathology result was negative. The primary site should be coded as branchial cleft (C104). Example 4: The patient underwent total hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy for non-cancer reasons ten years ago. Extensive cystadenocarcinoma is now found in the peritoneum. The primary site should be coded as peritoneum, NOS (C482). Example 5: The pathology report shows adenocarcinoma arising in a patch of endometriosis on the sigmoid colon. The primary site should be coded as sigmoid colon (C187). Example 6: The patient underwent a wedge resection of the left lower lip, and pathology showed invasive squamous cell carcinoma at the mucocutaneous junction. Neither the operative report nor the pathology report provides further information supporting a primary skin tumor. Because the mucocutaneous junction and the vermilion border are synonymous, and the vermilion border belongs to the external lower lip, the primary site should be coded as external lower lip (C001).
• Do not alter the primary site code to fit the stage or other field information.
• When a single tumor overlaps two or more subsites and its exact origin is also unclear, the 4th digit should be coded as 8. Example: A patient is diagnosed with a primary tumor of the cervicothoracic esophagus, but it cannot be clearly determined whether it originated in the cervical or the thoracic segment. The primary site should be coded as C158. Note: the following principles apply only to skin cancers overlapping sites in the head and neck:
• If a tumor spans multiple skin regions of the head and neck, code the primary site according to the location of the bulk of the tumor or its epicenter; do not use C448 (skin, overlapping subsites). If a single tumor spans both a reportable site and a non-reportable site, handle it according to the following principles: If the site of origin or the site with the greatest involvement is a reportable site, the case should be reported, using the corresponding primary site code.
• If the site of origin or the site with the greatest involvement is a non-reportable site, the case is not reported.
• For a case that is not a multiple primary, if a single anatomic site contains both invasive and in situ lesions in different subsites, the "primary site" should be coded according to the invasive component. Example 1: The patient has invasive breast cancer in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast and in situ tumors in multiple quadrants of the left breast. The primary site should be coded as upper-outer quadrant of breast (C504). Example 2: The patient has in situ Paget disease of the right nipple and infiltrating ductal carcinoma in the lower inner quadrant of the right breast. The primary site should be coded as lower-inner quadrant of breast (C503).
• If multiple tumors occur within the same anatomic site and are distributed in different subsites, but their actual site of origin cannot be clearly determined, treat them as a single primary and code the 4th digit of the primary site as 9. Example 1: The patient underwent transurethral resection of bladder tumor (TURBT), and the physician found multiple papillary tumors in the bladder neck (C675) and the lateral wall of the bladder (C672) during surgery. Because the tumors are located in different segments of the bladder and the actual site of origin cannot be determined, the primary site should be coded as bladder, NOS (C679). Example 2: Two infiltrating duct carcinomas are found in the right breast, located in the upper outer quadrant (C504) and the lower inner quadrant (C503) of the right breast, respectively. The primary site should be coded as breast, NOS (C509).
• After some ICD-O histology/behavior codes, the suggested related primary site code is shown in parentheses, for example: hepatoma (C220).
• When the primary site is clearly recorded in the medical record, code according to the actual primary site and ignore the site suggested by ICD-O. Example: The pathology report describes infiltrating duct carcinoma of the head of the pancreas. Although in ICD-O the suggested primary site for infiltrating duct carcinoma (8500/3) is breast (C50_), in this example the tumor actually arose in the head of the pancreas, so the correct primary site is C250 (head of pancreas); the suggested breast code C50_ must not be used by mistake.
• If the primary site recorded in the medical record is consistent with the site suggested by ICD-O, or the primary site is unknown, the primary site code suggested by ICD-O may be used. Example 1: Biopsy shows hepatoma, with no other primary site information. According to the ICD-O suggestion, the primary site is coded as liver (C220). Example 2: After excision of a right axillary lymph node, metastatic infiltrating duct carcinoma is found, but the right breast is negative. In ICD-O, the suggested site for infiltrating duct carcinoma (8500) is breast (C50_). With no other primary information, the primary site should be coded as breast, NOS (C509).
• If no information indicates that the tumor arose from another site, the corresponding site code may be used according to the ICD-O suggestion.
• For example: lymph node biopsy is diagnosed as metastatic non-small cell carcinoma, but the patient died before receiving treatment, and the medical record has no other information on the primary site. According to the ICD-O suggestion, the primary site should be coded as lung (C349).
• If Merkel cell carcinoma occurs in a lymph node or a distant metastatic site and no primary site can be found, code the primary site as C449 (skin, NOS).
• In the absence of any other information on the primary site, code according to the primary site/histology codes listed in the table below. Primary Site/Histology Topography Code Ampullary/peri-ampullary C241 Anal margin C445 Anal verge C211 Angle of the stomach C162 Angular incisura of stomach C163 Back of tongue C019 Book-leaf lesion (mouth) C068 Clavicular skin C445 Colored / lipstick portion of upper lip C000 Cutaneous leiomyosarcoma C44_ Distal conus C720 Edge of tongue C021 Frontoparietal (brain) C718 Gastric angular notch (incisura) C163 Gastrohepatic ligament C481 Genu of pancreas C250 Glossotonsillar sulcus C109 Incisura, incisura angularis C163 Infrahilar area of lung C349 Interarytenoid space C329 Interhemispheric fissure (cerebrum) C710 Intracranial C719 Lateral tongue C023 Leptomeninges C709 Masticator space C760 Mastoid or mastoid complex C301 Melanoma, NOS C449 Nail bed, thumb C446 Pancreatobiliary C269 Parapharyngeal space C139 Periareolar (breast) C501 Periclitoral C511 Perihilar bile duct C240 Porta hepatis C220 Postauricular region C444 Primary Site/Histology Topography Code Preauricular (skin) C443 Prostatic sinus (urethra) C680 Pterygomandibular raphé C069 Septum pellucidum C719 Testis, descended post orchiopexy C621 True vocal folds C320 Uncinate of pancreas C250 Ureterovesical junction (UVJ) C669 Code the primary site of the tumor, not the metastatic site. If the cancer is confirmed to be metastatic but the primary site cannot be identified, the primary site should be coded as unknown (C809). When the medical record lacks sufficient information to determine the primary site, code according to the following principles: Consult the physician for help in assigning an appropriate primary site code. If the physician also cannot confirm the primary site, use the NOS (not otherwise specified) category of the organ system, or use the ill-defined site category (Ill-Defined Site, C760-C768). Coding principles for occult tumors of the head and neck (Occult Tumors of the Head and Neck): If the patient has metastasis to cervical lymph nodes in levels I-VII or other lymph node groups, and the lymph node specimen is positive for EBER (Epstein-Barr virus (EBV+) Encoded small RNAs) by in situ hybridization, regardless of p16 expression status, the primary site should be coded as nasopharynx (C119). If the patient has metastasis to cervical lymph nodes in levels I-VII or other lymph node groups, and the tumor is p16-positive with histology consistent with human papillomavirus (HPV)-mediated oropharyngeal carcinoma (HPV-mediated oropharyngeal carcinoma, OPC), the primary site should be coded as oropharynx (C109). If it is only known that the cervical lymph nodes are positive and the primary site cannot be identified, the primary site should be coded as C760 (head and neck, NOS). If the medical record states two or more possible primary sites that all belong to the same system (such as the digestive system), code to the NOS code of that system. Example: if the medical record mentions the possible primary sites as colon and small intestine, the primary site should be coded as digestive tract, NOS (C269). Code "unknown primary site" (C809) only when the physician explicitly states that the primary site is unknown (unknown primary site) and none of the above rules apply. When the medical record contains insufficient information to determine the primary site, and the case also cannot be assigned to a not otherwise specified (NOS) or ill-defined site (Ill-Defined Site) category, the primary site should be coded as unknown (C809). Coding principles for malignant sarcoma (sarcoma): Most malignant sarcomas originate from mesenchymal or connective tissue, which is distributed in the musculoskeletal system and includes fat, muscle, blood vessels, deep skin tissue, nerves, bone and cartilage. For a malignant sarcoma with an unknown primary site, C499 should be coded in preference to C809. Besides soft tissue, sarcomas may also arise in the walls of hollow organs and in the viscera covering an organ (Sarcomas may also arise in the walls of hollow organs and in the viscera covering an organ.). In this case, the primary site should be coded as the organ in which the tumor arose. Example 1: The pathology report diagnoses carcinosarcoma of the uterine corpus; the primary site should be coded as corpus uteri (C549). Example 2: The patient is diagnosed with rhabdomyosarcoma of the ethmoid sinus; the primary site should be coded as ethmoid sinus (C311). When leiomyosarcoma occurs in a specific organ, code the organ of origin as the primary site; do not code it as soft tissue. Example 1: Leiomyosarcoma of the kidney; the primary site should be coded as kidney (C649). Example 2: Leiomyosarcoma of the prostate; the primary site should be coded as prostate (C619). For gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST), code the primary site according to the actual site of origin of the tumor. Angiosarcoma (Angiosarcoma) For angiosarcoma of the spleen, the primary site should be coded as spleen (C422). For angiosarcoma of the breast, the primary site should be coded as breast (C50_). Although angiosarcoma actually originates from vascular endothelial cells, angiosarcoma arising in the breast has a worse prognosis than other breast tumors, so it should still be regarded as arising from the breast. Coding principles for transplants (Transplants): If a malignant tumor occurs in a transplanted organ, code the primary site as the location of that organ, that is, the site where the tumor actually is or arose. Example: if the diagnosis is a malignant tumor arising in a transplanted segment of colon (used as the esophagus), the primary site should be coded as esophagus. For transplants related to hematopoietic or lymphoid neoplasms, refer to the Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual and Database. Coding principles for hematopoietic malignancies and lymphoma (Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Cancer, M9590-9993): Whether a hematopoietic malignancy or lymphoma is a single or multiple primary should be coded according to the rules of the latest published version of the SEER Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual and The Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasms Database (Hematopoietic DB), applicable to cases newly diagnosed on or after January 1, 2010. Examples: Code: Case
C108: Overlapping lesion of the oropharynx. For example, when a large tumor involves both the lateral wall of oropharynx (C10.2) and the posterior wall of oropharynx (C10.3) and its exact origin is unclear, the 4th digit should be 8.
C678: Overlapping lesion of the bladder. For example, when a large tumor involves both the dome (C67.1) and the lateral wall (C67.2) and its exact origin is unclear, the 4th digit should be 8.
C679: Bladder, NOS. When multiple tumors arise in the bladder trigone (C67.0) and the lateral wall (C67.2), the 4th digit should be 9.
C189: Colon, NOS. For a patient with familial polyposis who has invasive and in situ cancers from the transverse colon (C18.4) to the descending colon (C18.6), record it as one primary cancer, with site colon, NOS (C18.9). For a detailed explanation, see the section on multiple primaries in Part 1.
C16_: When a lymphoma is located in the stomach (extranodal lymphoma), code it directly with the subsite of the stomach.

fields.description_zh: 確認癌症起源於成對器官或身體的某一側。本欄位只適用於原發腫瘤部位。
fields.description_en: Confirms whether the cancer originated in a paired organ or a particular side of the body. This field applies only to the primary tumor site.
fields.purpose_zh: 側性可提供分期及癌病侵犯程度的資訊，並可確定原發侵犯的數目。
fields.guide_zh:
• 原發部位不明(C80.9)與非成對器官，其側性編碼為0；成對器官之編碼可以為1－5及9 (參看第一部份附加的資料) 。
• 若側位不詳，但是腫瘤是侷限於成對器官的某一側，編碼為3。
• 若確認原發側位別時，勿將對側轉移部位登錄為雙側侵犯。注意：若肺癌個案腫瘤雙側侵犯時，且無法確認原發側位別，則編碼為4。
• 原發部位為以下部位且為身體中線的腫瘤，編碼為5。 C700,C710-C714,C722-C725,C443,C444,C445。 若腫瘤非原發於以上部位時，則不可編碼為5。
• 非成對器官同時發現雙側侵犯時，則編碼為0。
• 非表列成對器官，若病歷記錄有描述側性則須登錄。範例：編碼：案例
0：甲狀腺癌個案病歷記載左右兩側侵犯。
3：病理報告記載個案有一個 2公分carcinoma位於腎臟upper pole處，其側位別編碼為3(因為只知道位置是在某ㄧ個腎，但是不知是左腎或右腎)。
9：個案診斷為肺癌，診斷依據為 sputum cytology，病歷上無其他任何與側位別相關資訊可提供。
5：個案肚臍正上方有一黑色素瘤，因皮膚為成對器官而腫瘤位於正中線腫瘤，故編碼為5。
1：右側口腔黏膜癌。
1：病歷記載為右側甲狀腺癌。
4：個案診斷為肺癌，影像報告顯示雙側腫瘤侵犯，醫師未明示或無法確認原發部位側性。
2：個案診斷為肺癌，影像報告顯示雙側腫瘤侵犯，醫師紀載原發部位為左側上葉(LUL)。
fields.purpose_en: Laterality provides information on stage and extent of disease and can determine the number of primary involvements.
fields.guide_en:
• If the primary site is unknown (C80.9) or the organ is not paired, code laterality 0; for paired organs the code may be 1-5 and 9 (see the additional information in Part 1).
• If laterality is unknown but the tumor is confined to one side of a paired organ, code 3.
• When the side of the primary is confirmed, do not register a contralateral metastatic site as bilateral involvement. Note: if a patient with lung cancer has bilateral tumor involvement and the side of the primary cannot be confirmed, code 4.
• For tumors on the midline of the body whose primary site is one of the following, code 5:• C700, C710-C714, C722-C725, C443, C444, C445.• If the tumor did not arise in the above sites, do not code 5.
• If bilateral involvement is found in a non-paired organ, code 0.
• For paired organs not listed, if the medical record describes laterality, it must be registered. Examples: Code: Case
0: The medical record of a patient with thyroid cancer documents involvement of both left and right sides.
3: The pathology report documents a 2 cm carcinoma at the upper pole of a kidney; its laterality is coded 3 (because it is only known to be in one kidney, but not whether left or right).
9: A patient is diagnosed with lung cancer on the basis of sputum cytology, and the medical record has no other information on laterality.
5: A patient has a melanoma directly above the umbilicus; because skin is a paired organ but the tumor is on the midline, code 5.
1: Carcinoma of the right oral mucosa.
1: The medical record documents right thyroid cancer.
4: A patient is diagnosed with lung cancer; the imaging report shows bilateral tumor involvement, and the physician did not state or it cannot be confirmed which side is the primary site.
2: A patient is diagnosed with lung cancer; the imaging report shows bilateral tumor involvement, and the physician documented the primary site as the left upper lobe (LUL).

fields.description_zh: 原發腫瘤細胞於顯微鏡下之結構。
fields.description_en: Structure of the primary tumor cells under the microscope.
fields.purpose_zh: 作為分期及決定治療方針之根據；同時也影響其預後及病程。
fields.guide_zh:
• 依ICD-O-3第69－104頁Numeric Lists/Morphology，以及第105－218頁中Alphabetic Index的部分來進行histology編碼。同時請遵循ICD-O-3第20－40頁之編碼規則予以編碼。
• ICD-O-3之組織病理碼(M-code)第一個字母為M，之後接著四個數字，本欄位編碼只需數字部份，勿將M字填入。
• 對所有可申報之實質腫瘤(solid tumors)於登錄其histology之決定時，請採用SEER「Solid Tumor coding rules」中之編碼原則。這些規則乃適用於2018年1月1日(含)以後新診斷為癌症個案，2017年12月31日(含)以前新診斷之癌症個案請勿採用此規則。
• 若有病理報告時，須檢閱所有的病理報告。
• 血液惡性疾病個案之組織病理碼(M-code)依血液疾病編碼表登錄。
• 實質癌症(solid tumors)，依病理報告最終診斷(final pathologic diagnosis)記載之組織型態(histology)逕行編碼。附註：若病理報告依 CAP採條列式描述可採用，亦可參考病理報告中的評論(comment)的描述。例外： 若病理報告最終診斷為「未明示(Not Otherwise Specified, NOS)」，如carcinoma, NOS、melanoma, NOS、lymphoma, NOS、或 malignant tumor, NOS，則須參考病理報告中的顯微鏡觀察或評論(comment)的描述，以確認更明確的編碼，例如：adenocarcinoma、amelanotic melanoma或 spindle cell sarcoma等。
• cancer, NOS (8000)和carcinoma, NOS (8010)二者不可互換(參考ICD-O-3，第27頁)。若醫師僅描述個案患有carcinoma，則以未明示癌編碼之(80100)。
• 對於血液惡性腫瘤及淋巴癌(Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Cancer【M9590-9993】是否為單一或多重原發，請依下列原則編碼：
• 2010年1月1日(含)以後新診斷個案：應遵循SEER「Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual」最新公告版本與The Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasms Database (Hematopoietic DB) 之規則編碼。
• 若病理標本取自轉移部位，因為原發部位與其轉移部位基本上是具有相同之histology，因此以轉移部位之histology逕行編碼，而性態碼則編碼為3。範例：編碼：標示 案例
8140：Adenocarcinoma 病理報告主診斷為prostate: carcinoma, NOS (8010)，其顯微鏡微觀(mircoscopic)敘述為 adenocarcinoma，則應編碼為 8140。
9680：Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma 病歷最後診斷是 lymphoma，但有任何紀錄 Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma的診斷時，應編碼為96800。
fields.purpose_en: Serves as the basis for staging and deciding treatment policy; also affects prognosis and disease course.
fields.guide_en:
• Code histology according to the Numeric Lists/Morphology on pages 69-104 and the Alphabetic Index on pages 105-218 of ICD-O-3, and follow the coding rules on pages 20-40 of ICD-O-3.
• The histology code (M-code) of ICD-O-3 begins with the letter M followed by four digits; this field requires only the digits; do not enter the letter M.
• For determining the histology of all reportable solid tumors, use the coding principles of the SEER "Solid Tumor coding rules". These rules apply to cases newly diagnosed with cancer on or after January 1, 2018; do not use these rules for cases newly diagnosed on or before December 31, 2017.
• If pathology reports are available, all pathology reports must be reviewed.
• For hematologic malignancy cases, the histology code (M-code) is recorded according to the hematologic disease coding table.
• For solid tumors, code directly from the histology recorded in the final pathologic diagnosis of the pathology report. Note: if the pathology report uses the CAP itemized (synoptic) format, it may be used, and the description in the comment of the pathology report may also be consulted. Exception: if the final diagnosis of the pathology report is "Not Otherwise Specified (NOS)", such as carcinoma, NOS, melanoma, NOS, lymphoma, NOS, or malignant tumor, NOS, the microscopic description or comment of the pathology report must be consulted to confirm a more specific code, for example adenocarcinoma, amelanotic melanoma or spindle cell sarcoma.
• cancer, NOS (8000) and carcinoma, NOS (8010) are not interchangeable (see ICD-O-3, page 27). If the physician only describes the case as having carcinoma, code it as carcinoma, NOS (80100).
• For determining whether hematopoietic and lymphoid cancers (Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Cancer [M9590-9993]) are single or multiple primaries, code according to the following principles:
• For cases newly diagnosed on or after January 1, 2010: follow the latest published version of the SEER "Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual" and the rules of The Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasms Database (Hematopoietic DB).
• If the pathology specimen was taken from a metastatic site, since the primary site and its metastatic site basically have the same histology, code directly with the histology of the metastatic site, and code the behavior code as 3. Examples: Code: Label Case
8140: Adenocarcinoma. The main diagnosis of the pathology report is prostate: carcinoma, NOS (8010), and its microscopic description is adenocarcinoma; code 8140.
9680: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. The final diagnosis in the medical record is lymphoma, but if there is any record of a diagnosis of Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, code 96800.

fields.description_zh: 記錄病理診斷中的性態碼。M-code中的第5 碼即為性態碼。
fields.description_en: Record the behavior code of the pathological diagnosis. The 5th digit of the M-code is the behavior code.
fields.purpose_zh: 病理醫師常使用benign(0)、borderline(1)、in situ(2)、malignant, primary site(3)、malignant, metastatic site(6)、或malignant, uncertain whether primary or metastatic site(9)來描述腫瘤的性態。其中性態碼為2、3、6或9(若為6或9者，須申報原發部位，且性態碼改為 3)的個案必須申報至癌症登記工作小組。
fields.guide_zh:
• 若原發腫瘤有惡性侵犯(malignant invasion)的部份，即使其侵犯程度或範圍非常有限(如：微侵犯microinvasion)，其性態碼一律編碼為3。
• 若病理標本取自轉移部位，因為原發部位與其轉移部位基本上是具有相同之histology，因此以轉移部位之組織類型逕行編碼，而性態碼則編碼為3。
• Stage 0 的癌症一般性態碼為2，除了Paget’s disease(8540/3) of nipple/areola(C50.0)，以及侷限於lamina propria 的結直腸癌。
• 注意：Paget’s disease僅發生於乳頭、乳暈(C50.0)且乳房其他部位未發現任何腫瘤時，若病理報告明示Paget’s disease為in situ時，可編碼為8540/2。
• 原位癌個案非復發或疾病惡化情況下，發現有淋巴或遠端轉移，則性態碼編碼為3。例如：結腸切片病理報告診斷為tubulovillous adenoma with microfocal carcinoma in situ，後續接受 colectomy 未發現殘餘腫瘤，該手術同時執行core liver biopsy 發現有adenocarcinoma，病歷記載肝臟腫瘤是結腸癌轉移，性態碼應從 2改為3。範例：編碼：案例
3：Intraductal carcinoma (8500/2) with focal areas of invasion.
1：Atypical meningioma (9539/1) invading bone of skull (the meninges, which line the skull, are capable of invading into the bone without being malignant; do not code as malignant unless it is specifically mentioned)
fields.purpose_en: Pathologists commonly describe tumor behavior as benign (0), borderline (1), in situ (2), malignant, primary site (3), malignant, metastatic site (6), or malignant, uncertain whether primary or metastatic site (9). Cases with behavior code 2, 3, 6 or 9 (for 6 or 9, the primary site must be reported and the behavior code changed to 3) must be reported to the cancer registry working group.
fields.guide_en:
• If the primary tumor has a malignant invasion (malignant invasion) component, even if the degree or extent of invasion is very limited (such as microinvasion), the behavior code is always coded 3.
• If the pathology specimen is taken from a metastatic site, because the primary site and its metastatic site basically have the same histology, code directly the histology type of the metastatic site, and code the behavior code as 3.
• The behavior code for Stage 0 cancers is generally 2, except Paget's disease (8540/3) of the nipple/areola (C50.0) and colorectal cancer confined to the lamina propria.
• Note: when Paget's disease occurs only in the nipple or areola (C50.0) and no tumor is found elsewhere in the breast, and the pathology report explicitly states that the Paget's disease is in situ, it may be coded 8540/2.
• If a carcinoma in situ patient, without recurrence or disease progression, is found to have lymphatic or distant metastasis, code the behavior code as 3. For example: the colon biopsy pathology report diagnosed tubulovillous adenoma with microfocal carcinoma in situ; the subsequent colectomy found no residual tumor, but core liver biopsy performed during the same surgery found adenocarcinoma, and the medical record states that the liver tumor is metastasis from colon cancer; the behavior code should be changed from 2 to 3. Examples: Code: Case
3: Intraductal carcinoma (8500/2) with focal areas of invasion.
1: Atypical meningioma (9539/1) invading bone of skull (the meninges, which line the skull, are capable of invading into the bone without being malignant; do not code as malignant unless it is specifically mentioned)

fields.description_zh: 收錄實質腫瘤於首次治療前的分級/分化。分級/分化為腫瘤和正常組織的相似的程度。Well differentiated (Grade I)和正常組織最相似；Undifferentiated (Grade IV)和正常組織差異最大。
fields.description_en: Records the grade/differentiation of solid tumors before the first treatment. Grade/differentiation is the degree of similarity between the tumor and normal tissue. Well differentiated (Grade I) is most similar to normal tissue; Undifferentiated (Grade IV) differs most from normal tissue.
fields.purpose_zh: 與個案的預後有關。分級/分化可用以評估癌症嚴重程度；分級/分化及細胞型態對於許多癌症而言是重要的預後因子。分級/分化對於某些癌症更是判定臨床期別的依據之一。
fields.guide_zh:
 請依據AJCC第八版所建議的各癌別特殊分級/分化、一般分級/分化、字辭學摘錄；請參照手冊總論及附錄D。 本欄位僅摘錄實質腫瘤於首次治療前的分級/分化。 進行診斷性FNA、biopsy、needle core biopsy等組織病理學檢查並有描述分級/分化者，應記錄其臨床分級/分化。 臨床分級/分化請優先摘錄切片(biopsy、needle core biopsy)的病理報告；若未執行切片，則可參考細胞學報告。若有執行切片，但切片之病理報告無描述時，即使同時有細胞學檢查而且細胞學檢查報告有明示分級/分化，仍不採用細胞學檢查之資訊，分級/分化應編碼為9。 中樞神經系統應摘錄 WHO之分級/分化，請參照附錄 D。 實質腫瘤(solid tumor)之臨床分級/分化請依下列優先順序編碼︰ 各癌症部位特殊分級分化系統(site-special grade system)；請參考附錄D。 一般分級分化(generic grade)；請參考附錄D。 字辭學(terminology)；請參考總論。 分級/分化程度只能依原發部位經顯微鏡證實(病理學或細胞學)之報告結果編碼，勿採用轉移部位或復發的分級/分化程度，即使是轉移部位或復發的組織型態本身就含有分級/分化之意仍不採用。 原發部位已侵犯至鄰近器官，由鄰近器官取得病理組織，應視為原發腫瘤故可依據該病理報告描述之分級/分化結果逕行編碼。 若原發部位不明，應編碼為9 (分級/分化程度不詳)。 若病灶同時包括in situ和invasive時，應依其invasive部分的分級/分化程度編碼；但若其invasive部分之分級/分化程度不明，則編碼為9。 通常原位癌腫瘤是沒有分級的。若腫瘤是原位癌病灶(in situ lesions)之腫瘤組織有描述其分級/分化程度，可以此病灶的分級/分化程度來進行編碼。 若有超過一份以上的病理報告，且各報告之最終診斷的分級/分化不盡相同，則請依以下規則作為編碼之優先順序： 優先編碼AJCC第八版所建議之分級/分化(specific grading systems)，編碼為1-5。 若無AJCC第八版所建議之分級/分化，則以一般分級/分化(generic grade)之最高碼為主，編碼為A-D，L，H。 若癌症部位不適用於AJCC第八版，則請參考附錄D，分級/分化以最高碼為主。 若病理報告中主診斷(final diagnosis)未記載分化程度，則參考其顯微描述(Microscopic description)、補充說明(addendum)或評論(comment)的內容予以編碼。 若無病理組織報告，其分級/分化程度可參考磁振造影術(MRI)或正子造影術(PET)等報告上之描述進行編碼。 血液腫瘤(M-code 9590-9993)之分級/分化，自2018診斷年起一律編碼為8(不適用)；僅Lymphoma Ocular Adnexa (C44.1, C69.0, C69.5, C69.6)且組織型態為follicular lymphoma (M-code 9690/3, 9691/3, 9695/3, 9698/3)，需編碼分級/分化，請參考Grade 19及AJCC第八版第71章。 對於dysplasia，請勿編碼其分級程度，例如High grade dysplasia應編碼為X。 卵 巢 borderline tumor (Low malignant potential) 合 併 microinvasive carcinoma 或 / 與intraepithelial carcinoma，本欄位應編碼為X。 闌尾(Appendix)組織型態為 Low grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (LAMN)或High grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (HAMN)，應分別編碼為L或H。 編碼9(不詳)： 分化/分級不明或病歷未記載。 首次治療前未有臨床分級/分化。 術後才診斷為癌症。 當病歷中只有一個分級/分化，且無法區分是臨床或是病理時，應編碼於臨床分級/分化中，病理分級/分化應編碼9 (不詳)。範例：編碼：案例
1：Buccal mucosa cancer 個案接受切片檢查，病理切片報告描述為：squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated，後續接受 wide excision，病理報告描述為 squamous cell carcinoma in situ。因切片檢查為診斷性處置，不可視為切除性手術。
3：食道癌個案，其病理切片報告為：squamous cell carcinoma, poorly differentiated，經手術治療切除腫瘤，其手術病理報告為：squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated，
9：乳癌個案手術前病理切片報告未描述分級/分化，CSRT後切除腫瘤，病理報告描述分級/分化為Grade 2。
9：個案病理切片報告為 Sclerosing liposarcoma （M-code：8851/3），未描述分級/分化。
3：個案MRI報告描述 corpus striatum tumor 且診斷為Anaplastic oligodendroglioma。病歷記錄未描述 WHO grade，參考附錄D中的Grade 20 並對應table.1 為WHO Grade III，則可編碼為 3。
9：個案病理切片報告為 C4-5，biopsy of intramedullary tumor，組織型態為Ependymoma,with Molecular Testing RELA fusion-positive，病理報告未描述 WHO grade。參考附錄 D中的Grade 20 並對應 table.1仍無法判定WHO Grade，則應編碼為9。
2：個案MRI報告描述 Diffuse astrocytoma，low grade。參考附錄D 中的Grade 20 並對應table.1為WHO Grade II，則可編碼為 2。編碼：案例
L：個案MRI報告描述 Glioma，low grade。參考附錄D中的Grade 20 並對應table.1並無WHO grade可參考，則可編碼為 L。
9：肺癌個案同時接受 RUL, fine-needle aspiration 及 CT-guide biopsy。Fine-needle aspiration 病理報告描述 Poorly differentiated carcinoma；而CT-guide biopsy 病理報告結果為Adenocarcinoma，未描述分級/分化，不應摘錄細胞學檢查之分級/分化。
H：個案由影像診斷為 Renal pelvis cancer ，並接受ureteroscope biopsy，切片病理報告為Papillary urothelial carcinoma, high grade；之後執行nephroureterectomy，手術後的病理報告描述為 no residual tumor，臨床及病理分級/分化皆編碼為 H。
fields.purpose_en: Related to the prognosis of the case. Grade/differentiation can be used to assess the severity of cancer; grade/differentiation and cell type are important prognostic factors for many cancers. For some cancers, grade/differentiation is also one of the bases for determining clinical stage.
fields.guide_en:
• Abstract the site-specific grade/differentiation, generic grade/differentiation, and terminology recommended by the AJCC 8th edition for each cancer type; refer to the General Introduction and Appendix D of the manual.• This field records only the grade/differentiation of solid tumors before the first course of treatment.• If a diagnostic histopathologic examination such as FNA, biopsy or needle core biopsy was performed and describes grade/differentiation, record its clinical grade/differentiation.• For the clinical grade/differentiation, abstract the pathology report of the biopsy (biopsy, needle core biopsy) first; if no biopsy was performed, the cytology report may be consulted. If a biopsy was performed but its pathology report has no description, do not use the cytology information even if a cytology examination was done at the same time and its report explicitly states the grade/differentiation; code the grade/differentiation as 9.• For the central nervous system, abstract the WHO grade/differentiation; see Appendix D.• Code the clinical grade/differentiation of solid tumors in the following order of priority:• Site-specific grade system for each cancer site; see Appendix D.• Generic grade; see Appendix D.• Terminology; see the General Introduction.• Grade/differentiation may be coded only from microscopically confirmed (pathology or cytology) reports of the primary site. Do not use the grade/differentiation of a metastatic or recurrent site, even if the histology of the metastasis or recurrence itself implies a grade/differentiation.• If the primary site has invaded an adjacent organ and pathologic tissue is obtained from the adjacent organ, it should be regarded as the primary tumor, so the grade/differentiation described in that pathology report may be coded directly.• If the primary site is unknown, code 9 (grade/differentiation unknown).• If the lesion includes both in situ and invasive components, code the grade/differentiation of the invasive component; if the grade/differentiation of the invasive component is unknown, code 9.• In situ carcinomas are usually not graded. If the tumor tissue of an in situ lesion has a described grade/differentiation, that grade/differentiation of the lesion may be used for coding.• If there is more than one pathology report and the grades/differentiation in their final diagnoses differ, use the following order of priority for coding:• Code first the grade/differentiation recommended by the AJCC 8th edition (specific grading systems), coded 1-5.• If the AJCC 8th edition does not recommend a grade/differentiation, use mainly the highest code of the generic grade, coded A-D, L, H.• If the cancer site is not covered by the AJCC 8th edition, refer to Appendix D and use mainly the highest grade/differentiation code.• If the final diagnosis of the pathology report does not state the degree of differentiation, refer to the microscopic description, addendum or comment for coding.• If there is no histopathology report, the grade/differentiation may be coded from descriptions in reports such as magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) or positron emission tomography (PET).• For hematologic neoplasms (M-code 9590-9993), grade/differentiation is always coded 8 (not applicable) from diagnosis year 2018; only for Lymphoma Ocular Adnexa (C44.1, C69.0, C69.5, C69.6) with follicular lymphoma histology (M-code 9690/3, 9691/3, 9695/3, 9698/3) must grade/differentiation be coded; see Grade 19 and Chapter 71 of the AJCC 8th edition.• For dysplasia, do not code a grade; for example, high grade dysplasia should be coded X.• For ovarian borderline tumor (low malignant potential) with microinvasive carcinoma and/or intraepithelial carcinoma, code X in this field.• For appendix histology of low grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (LAMN) or high grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (HAMN), code L or H, respectively.• Code 9 (unknown):• Differentiation/grade unknown or not documented in the medical record.• No clinical grade/differentiation before the first course of treatment.• Cancer diagnosed only after surgery.• When the medical record contains only one grade/differentiation and it cannot be distinguished as clinical or pathologic, code it in the clinical grade/differentiation and code the pathologic grade/differentiation as 9 (unknown).Examples: Code: Case
1: A patient with buccal mucosa cancer underwent biopsy, and the biopsy pathology report reads squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated; the patient subsequently underwent wide excision, and the pathology report reads squamous cell carcinoma in situ. Because a biopsy is a diagnostic procedure, it must not be regarded as a resection.
3: A patient with esophageal cancer; the biopsy pathology report reads squamous cell carcinoma, poorly differentiated; the tumor was resected surgically, and the surgical pathology report reads squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated,
9: A patient with breast cancer; the pre-operative biopsy pathology report does not describe grade/differentiation; the tumor was resected after CSRT, and the pathology report describes the grade/differentiation as Grade 2.
9: The patient's biopsy pathology report reads Sclerosing liposarcoma (M-code: 8851/3), with no grade/differentiation described.
3: The patient's MRI report describes a corpus striatum tumor, diagnosed as Anaplastic oligodendroglioma. The medical record does not describe the WHO grade; referring to Grade 20 in Appendix D and matching it to Table 1 gives WHO Grade III, so code 3.
9: The patient's biopsy pathology report reads C4-5, biopsy of intramedullary tumor, histology Ependymoma, with Molecular Testing RELA fusion-positive; the pathology report does not describe the WHO grade. After referring to Grade 20 in Appendix D and matching it to Table 1, the WHO Grade still cannot be determined, so code 9.
2: The patient's MRI report describes Diffuse astrocytoma, low grade. Referring to Grade 20 in Appendix D and matching it to Table 1 gives WHO Grade II, so code 2. Code: Case
L: The patient's MRI report describes Glioma, low grade. Referring to Grade 20 in Appendix D and matching it to Table 1, there is no WHO grade to refer to, so code L.
9: A patient with lung cancer underwent both RUL fine-needle aspiration and CT-guided biopsy. The fine-needle aspiration pathology report describes Poorly differentiated carcinoma, while the CT-guided biopsy pathology report shows Adenocarcinoma with no grade/differentiation described; the grade/differentiation of the cytology examination should not be abstracted.
H: A patient was diagnosed on imaging with renal pelvis cancer and underwent ureteroscope biopsy; the biopsy pathology report reads Papillary urothelial carcinoma, high grade; nephroureterectomy was performed afterwards, and the post-operative pathology report describes no residual tumor; both the clinical and pathologic grade/differentiation are coded H.

fields.description_zh: 收錄實質腫瘤於原發部位手術之後的分級/分化。分級/分化為腫瘤和正常組織的相似的程度。Well differentiated (Grade I)和正常組織最相似；Undifferentiated (Grade IV)和正常組織差異最大。
fields.description_en: Records the grade/differentiation of solid tumors after surgery at the primary site. Grade/differentiation is the degree of similarity between the tumor and normal tissue. Well differentiated (Grade I) is most similar to normal tissue; Undifferentiated (Grade IV) differs most from normal tissue.
