fields.description_zh: 記錄摘錄此癌症登記個案人員之癌症登記證照編號或姓名。
fields.description_en: Records the cancer registry certification number or name of the person who abstracted this cancer registry case.
fields.purpose_zh: 作為申報醫院內部於數名工作人員在資料庫之品質管控與管理。
fields.guide_zh:
• 優先摘錄癌症登記技術人員進階級認證字號；若無進階認證字號，則摘錄癌症登記技術人員基礎級認證字號；若兩者認證皆無，則摘錄姓名。
• 編碼癌症登記技術人員進階級與基礎級認證字號共八碼：前三碼為民國年；第四碼為A(進階級)或B(基礎級)；後四碼為認證字號。例如1：林員通過癌症登記技術人員進階級認證，應記錄(105)癌登進證字第0001。例如2：林員僅通過癌症登記技術人員基礎級認證，應記錄(098)癌登基證字第0001號。例如3：林員未通過癌症登記技術人員基礎級及進階級認證，應記錄其姓名林OO。範例：編碼：案例
105B0001：林員通過癌症登記技術人員基礎級認證，摘錄者依據基礎認證字號為(105)癌登基證字第0001 號來編碼。
099A0108：陳員通過癌症登記記術人員進階級認證，摘錄者依據進階認證字號為(099)癌登進證字第0108 號來編碼。其他因子
fields.purpose_en: Used for quality control and management of the database by several staff members within the reporting hospital.
fields.guide_en:
• Abstract first the registrar's advanced-level certification number; if there is no advanced-level number, abstract the registrar's basic-level certification number; if neither certification exists, abstract the name.
• The cancer registrar advanced-level and basic-level certification numbers are coded in eight characters: the first three are the ROC year; the fourth is A (advanced level) or B (basic level); the last four are the certification number. Example 1: Registrar Lin passed the advanced-level certification for cancer registrars and should record (105) Cancer Registry Advanced Certificate No. 0001. Example 2: Registrar Lin passed only the basic-level certification for cancer registrars and should record (098) Cancer Registry Basic Certificate No. 0001. Example 3: Registrar Lin has passed neither the basic-level nor advanced-level certification for cancer registrars and should record the name, Lin OO. Examples: Code: Case
105B0001: Registrar Lin passed the basic-level certification for cancer registrars, and the abstractor coded according to the basic certification number (105) Cancer Registry Basic Certificate No. 0001.
099A0108: Registrar Chen passed the advanced-level certification for cancer registrars, and the abstractor coded according to the advanced certification number (099) Cancer Registry Advanced Certificate No. 0108. Other factors

fields.description_zh: 記錄個案於首次治療前的身高。
fields.description_en: record case's height before first treatment.
fields.purpose_zh: 肥胖是致癌的危險因子，為瞭解個案肥胖狀態，需得知個案身體質量指數(BMI)，而身高是計算BMI所需數值。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案於癌症首次療程前一年內，最近一次病歷所記載身高的資料。
• 請直接摘錄個案的身高數值並四捨五入至個位數。 身高小於100cm：四捨五入後不足三碼者請補 0；例如身高75.3cm，編碼075。 身高大於100cm：四捨五入後滿三碼者請直接摘錄；例如身高102.5cm，編碼103。
fields.purpose_en: Obesity is a carcinogenic risk factor. To understand the case's obesity status, the body mass index (BMI) is needed, and height is a value required to calculate BMI.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the case's height as documented in the most recent medical record within one year before the first course of cancer treatment.
• Abstract the case's height value directly, rounded to the nearest integer. Height below 100cm: if the rounded value has fewer than three digits, pad with 0; for example, height 75.3cm is coded 075. Height of 100cm or more: if the rounded value has three digits, abstract it directly; for example, height 102.5cm is coded 103.

fields.description_zh: 記錄個案於首次治療前的體重。
fields.description_en: record case's weight before first treatment.
fields.purpose_zh: 肥胖是致癌的危險因子，為瞭解個案肥胖狀態，需得知個案身體質量指數(BMI)，而體重是計算BMI所需數值。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案於癌症首次療程前一年內，最近一次病歷所記載體重的資料。
• 請直接摘錄個案的體重數值並四捨五入至個位數。 體重小於100kg：四捨五入後不足三碼者請補 0；例如體重75.3kg，編碼075。 體重大於100kg：四捨五入後滿三碼者請直接摘錄；例如體重102.5kg，編碼103。
fields.purpose_en: Obesity is a carcinogenic risk factor. To understand the case's obesity status, the body mass index (BMI) is needed, and weight is a value required to calculate BMI.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the weight documented in the most recent medical record within one year before the first course of cancer treatment.
• Abstract the case's weight value directly and round it to a whole number. For weight under 100kg: if the rounded value has fewer than three digits, pad with 0; for example, a weight of 75.3kg is coded 075. For weight over 100kg: if the rounded value has three digits, abstract it directly; for example, a weight of 102.5kg is coded 103.

fields.description_zh: 記錄個案於最初診斷日前的吸菸行為。
fields.description_en: Records the case's smoking behavior before the date of initial diagnosis.
fields.purpose_zh: 吸菸是致癌的危險因子。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案於最初診斷日前一年內，最近一次病歷所記載吸菸行為的資料。
• 若病歷無記載個案於最初診斷日前吸菸資訊，則摘錄癌症首次療程前最近一次病歷所記載之吸菸資訊。
• 此欄位共6碼，說明如下： 1-2碼為每日吸菸量(以支為單位)；每日吸菸量≧90支，編碼90。 3-4碼為吸菸年。 5-6碼為戒菸年；但戒菸時間如未達1個月(30天)者，則視為未戒菸。
• 若吸菸量、吸菸年、戒菸年等資訊有小數點者，皆採無條件進位。例如：吸菸1.3年，吸菸年編碼為 02。
• 若吸菸量、吸菸年、戒菸年等資訊僅有粗略值，應摘錄最大值。例如1：每日吸菸量 5-6支、吸菸3-5年、戒菸 1-2年，則編碼060502。例如2：每日吸菸量＞6支、吸菸＞5年、戒菸＞2年，則編碼060502。
• 若病歷僅記載吸菸(+)但未有數值者，編碼989800；從未吸菸者，編碼000088(不適用)。
• 病歷未記載或吸菸狀態完全不詳者，請編碼999999。此欄位共6碼，說明如下：舉例：
fields.purpose_en: Smoking is a carcinogenic risk factor.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the smoking behavior documented in the most recent medical record within one year before the initial diagnosis date.
• If the medical record has no smoking information before the initial diagnosis date, abstract the smoking information documented in the most recent medical record before the first course of cancer treatment.
• This field has 6 digits, explained as follows: Digits 1-2 are the daily smoking amount (in cigarettes); a daily amount ≧90 cigarettes is coded 90. Digits 3-4 are smoking years. Digits 5-6 are years since quitting; however, if the duration of quitting is less than 1 month (30 days), the case is regarded as not having quit.
• If the smoking amount, smoking years or quitting years have decimals, always round up. For example: smoking 1.3 years is coded 02 for smoking years.
• If the smoking amount, smoking years or quitting years are only rough values, abstract the maximum value. Example 1: daily smoking amount 5-6 cigarettes, smoking 3-5 years, quit 1-2 years is coded 060502. Example 2: daily smoking amount >6 cigarettes, smoking >5 years, quit >2 years is coded 060502.
• If the medical record only documents smoking (+) without values, code 989800; for never smokers, code 000088 (not applicable).
• If smoking is not documented in the medical record or the smoking status is completely unknown, code 999999. This field has 6 digits, explained as follows: Examples:

fields.description_zh: 記錄個案於最初診斷日前的嚼檳榔行為。
fields.description_en: Records the case's betel quid chewing behavior before the date of initial diagnosis.
fields.purpose_zh: 嚼檳榔是致癌的危險因子。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案於最初診斷日前一年內，最近一次病歷所記載嚼檳榔行為的資料。
• 若病歷無記載個案於最初診斷日前嚼檳榔資訊，則摘錄癌症首次療程前最近一次病歷所記載之嚼檳榔資訊。
• 此欄位共6碼，說明如下： 1-2碼為每日嚼檳榔量(以顆為單位)；每日嚼檳榔量≧90顆，編碼90。 3-4碼為嚼檳榔年。 5-6碼為戒檳榔年；但戒嚼檳榔時間如未達1個月(30天)者，則視為未戒嚼檳榔。
• 若嚼檳榔量、嚼檳榔年、戒嚼檳榔年等資訊有小數點者，皆採無條件進位。例如：嚼檳榔1.3 年，嚼檳榔年編碼為 02。
• 若嚼檳榔量、嚼檳榔年、戒嚼檳榔年等資訊僅有粗略值，應摘錄最大值。例如1：每日嚼檳榔 5-6顆、嚼檳榔3-5年、戒嚼檳榔1-2年，則編碼 060502。例如2：每日嚼檳榔＞6顆、嚼檳榔＞5年、戒嚼檳榔＞2年，則編碼 060502。
• 若病歷僅記載嚼檳榔(+)但未有數值者，編碼989800；從未嚼檳榔者，編碼000088(不適用)。
• 病歷未記載或嚼檳榔狀態完全不詳者，請編碼999999。此欄位共6碼，說明如下：舉例：
fields.purpose_en: Betel quid chewing is a carcinogenic risk factor.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the case's betel nut chewing data as documented in the most recent medical record within one year before the date of initial diagnosis.
• If the medical record has no betel nut chewing information before the date of initial diagnosis, abstract the betel nut chewing information documented in the most recent medical record before the first course of cancer treatment.
• This field has 6 digits, explained as follows: Digits 1-2: daily betel nut quantity (in units of pieces); if the daily quantity is ≧90 pieces, code 90. Digits 3-4: years of betel nut chewing. Digits 5-6: years since quitting betel nut; if the time since quitting is less than 1 month (30 days), the case is regarded as not having quit.
• If the betel nut quantity, years of chewing, years since quitting, etc. contain decimals, always round up. For example: chewing betel nut for 1.3 years, code the years of chewing as 02.
• If the betel nut quantity, years of chewing, years since quitting, etc. are only rough values, abstract the maximum value. Example 1: daily betel nut 5-6 pieces, chewing for 3-5 years, quit for 1-2 years: code 060502. Example 2: daily betel nut >6 pieces, chewing >5 years, quit >2 years: code 060502.
• If the medical record only records betel nut chewing (+) without values, code 989800; for a case who never chewed betel nut, code 000088 (not applicable).
• If the medical record has no record or the betel nut chewing status is completely unknown, code 999999. This field has 6 digits, explained as follows: Examples:

fields.description_zh: 記錄個案於最初診斷日前的喝酒行為。
fields.description_en: Records the case's alcohol drinking behavior before the date of initial diagnosis.
fields.purpose_zh: 喝酒是致癌的危險因子。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案於最初診斷日前一年內，最近一次病歷所記載喝酒行為的資料。
• 若病歷無記載個案於最初診斷日前喝酒資訊，則摘錄癌症首次療程前最近一次病歷所記載之喝酒資訊。
fields.purpose_en: Alcohol drinking is a carcinogenic risk factor.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the drinking behavior recorded in the most recent medical record within one year before the date of initial diagnosis.
• If the medical record has no drinking information before the date of initial diagnosis, abstract the drinking information recorded in the most recent medical record before the first course of treatment of the cancer.

fields.description_zh: 記錄與癌症預後和治療決策相關之其他因子
fields.description_en: Records other factors related to cancer prognosis and treatment decisions
fields.purpose_zh: 因應臨床實務需求及癌症診療品質提升。
fields.guide_zh: • 其他因子6、8-10為系統保留欄位，請編碼為988。
fields.purpose_en: In response to clinical practice needs and to improve the quality of cancer care.
fields.guide_en: • Other factors 6 and 8-10 are system-reserved fields; code them 988.

fields.description_zh: 記錄個案有血緣關係之家庭成員中是否患有相同癌症的家族病史。
fields.description_en: Records whether blood-related family members of the case have the same cancer (family history).
fields.purpose_zh: 家族病史為致癌的危險因子之一。
fields.guide_zh:
 自2025年起新診斷之個案應申報此欄位。 摘錄個案於申報日前，至最初診斷日往前回溯至少一年期間，病歷中所記載同癌家族史的資料。 此欄位僅收錄有血緣關係之家庭成員是否罹患相同癌症的家族史。肺癌個案僅登錄肺癌家族史，而不登錄其他非肺癌的家族史。 此欄位為肺癌、乳癌、結直腸癌必填欄位。若非前述癌別但有家族史資訊仍可申報，無家族史資訊應編碼為999999。 有血緣關係之家庭成員係依遺傳學之血親級別來分類： 第一級血親First-Degree Relative (FDR) by blood表示與個案約有50%的共同基因，包括父母、手足(兄弟姊妹)及子女。 第二級血親Second-Degree Relative (SDR) by blood表示與個案約有25%的共同基因，包括祖父母、外祖父母、孫子孫女、外孫子孫女、父親之親兄弟姊妹、母親之親兄弟姊妹 (伯叔姑舅姨)、同父異母之兄弟姊妹、同母異父之兄弟姊妹、兄弟之子女(侄與姪女)，及姊妹之子女(外甥或外甥女)。 第三級血親Third-Degree Relative (TDR) by blood表示與個案約有12.5%的共同基因，包括堂兄弟姊妹與表兄弟姊妹、曾祖父母、外曾祖父母、曾孫子曾孫女、外曾孫子曾孫女。注意：此遺傳學之血親級別與民法親等(一等親、二等親、三等親)之定義不同，勿混淆! 此欄位共六碼，僅登錄第一級血親，其餘血親不登錄；編碼由左至右說明如下： 第一碼為父親是否罹患相同癌症。 第二碼為母親是否罹患相同癌症。 第三碼為兄弟是否罹患相同癌症，且須考慮人數。 第四碼為姊妹是否罹患相同癌症，且須考慮人數。 第五碼為兒子是否罹患相同癌症，且須考慮人數 第六碼為女兒是否罹患相同癌症，且須考慮人數。 編碼0為未罹患相同癌症，編碼1為一人有罹患，編碼2為其中兩人有罹患，以此類推。例如1：個案為大腸癌，個案的父親及母親皆罹患大腸癌，哥哥和兒子未罹患，編碼110000。例如2：個案為乳癌，個案的父親罹患肺癌，母親未罹患癌症，但姐姐和妹妹都罹患乳癌，1位女兒也罹患乳癌，編碼000201。 若個案罹患男女特殊癌症，則其相對性別之父母/兄弟姊妹/子女則應編碼為0。例如1：男性個案罹患攝護腺癌，則母親應編碼為0，不可編碼為1或9，姊妹及女兒也應編碼為0，不可編碼為1-9。例如2：女性個案為卵巢癌，則父親應編碼為0，兄弟及兒子也應編碼為0。 若病歷上未明示父母親、手足或子女是否罹患相同癌症，則可視為無罹患，編碼為0。例如1：個案為大腸癌，病歷上描述：brother，colon cancer，編碼001000。例如2：個案為肺癌，病歷上描述：Father-SCLC，Sister-lung adenocarcinoma，編碼100100。 若病歷上僅描述手足或子女罹患癌症，但不清楚性別，則於手足或子女欄位中編碼A。例如1：個案為肺癌，病歷上描述為肺癌(手足)，編碼為00AA00。例如2：個案為結腸癌，病歷上僅描述孩子有罹患大腸癌，編碼為0000AA。 若病歷上描述個案的親生父母不詳或僅有養父養母，則編碼為9；若無親生兄弟姊妹或無親生子女，則編碼為X。例如：個案為肺癌，個案的父親罹患大腸癌，母親和2個妹妹皆無罹患癌症，無子女，編碼0000XX。 若病歷上描述個案自述不清楚父母、手足、子女是否有罹患相同癌症，則編碼為9。 若病歷上未記載個案之家族癌症史，則編碼為999999。範例：編碼：案例
000000：個案為肺癌，個案之父母親、手足及子女皆未罹患肺癌。
100000：個案為肺癌，病歷記載個案的父親患有肺癌。
010100：個案為肺癌，母親患有肺癌，1 位妹妹也患有肺癌，子女無罹患。
000000：個案為卵巢癌，母親未罹患，妹妹罹患肺癌，子女皆無罹患。
009900：個案為大腸癌，父母親未罹患大腸癌，兒子有罹患肺癌，但不清楚手足是否罹患。
00XXXX：個案為乳癌，自述為獨生女也無子女，父母親皆未罹患。
002101：個案為直腸癌，有多位手足與子女，2 位弟弟、1 位姊姊、女兒 1 人皆罹患直腸癌。父母親則未罹患。
011100：個案為大腸癌，病歷描述母親，哥哥和妹妹皆罹患大腸癌。
090110：個案為直腸癌，父親未罹患直腸癌，母親不清楚；姊姊和 1位兒子也罹患直腸癌。
999999：個案確診肺癌後，即離院且未再回診，病歷未記載任何癌症家族史。
9999XX：乳癌個案和家人失去聯繫，不清楚父母和手足是否有罹患癌症，無子女。
100000：個案為攝護腺癌，父親也罹患攝護腺癌，姐姐罹患大腸癌。
00AA00：個案為肺癌，病歷上家族史描述為肺癌(手足)，無其他資訊。
999999：個案為肝癌，病歷未記載任何癌症家族史。
fields.purpose_en: Family history is one of the carcinogenic risk factors.
fields.guide_en:
• This field must be reported for cases newly diagnosed from 2025. • Abstract the family history of the same cancer recorded in the medical record, covering the period from the report date back to at least one year before the date of initial diagnosis. • This field records only whether blood-related family members have had the same cancer. For a lung cancer patient, record only the family history of lung cancer, and do not record family history of other, non-lung cancers. • This field is mandatory for lung cancer, breast cancer and colorectal cancer. For other cancer types, family history information may still be reported if available; if there is no family history information, code 999999. • Blood-related family members are classified by genetic degree of relationship: • First-Degree Relative (FDR) by blood share about 50% of genes with the patient, and include parents, siblings (brothers and sisters) and children. • Second-Degree Relative (SDR) by blood share about 25% of genes with the patient, and include paternal and maternal grandparents, grandchildren, the father's full siblings, the mother's full siblings (uncles and aunts), half-siblings sharing the same father, half-siblings sharing the same mother, the children of brothers (nephews and nieces), and the children of sisters (nephews and nieces). • Third-Degree Relative (TDR) by blood share about 12.5% of genes with the patient, and include cousins (paternal and maternal), great-grandparents (paternal and maternal), and great-grandchildren. Note: this genetic degree of relationship differs from the definition of degrees of kinship (first-, second-, third-degree relatives) in the Civil Code; do not confuse them! • This field has six digits and records only first-degree relatives; other relatives are not recorded. The coding, from left to right, is as follows: • The 1st digit is whether the father had the same cancer. • The 2nd digit is whether the mother had the same cancer. • The 3rd digit is whether brothers had the same cancer, and the number of persons must be considered. • The 4th digit is whether sisters had the same cancer, and the number of persons must be considered. • The 5th digit is whether sons had the same cancer, and the number of persons must be considered • The 6th digit is whether daughters had the same cancer, and the number of persons must be considered. • Code 0 means no one had the same cancer, code 1 means one person had it, code 2 means two of them had it, and so on. Example 1: The patient has colorectal cancer; both the father and the mother had colorectal cancer, and the older brother and the son did not; code 110000. Example 2: The patient has breast cancer; the father had lung cancer, the mother had no cancer, but the older sister and the younger sister both had breast cancer, and 1 daughter also had breast cancer; code 000201. • If the patient has a sex-specific cancer, the relatives of the opposite sex (parents/siblings/children) should be coded 0. Example 1: A male patient has prostate cancer; the mother should be coded 0 (not 1 or 9), and sisters and daughters should also be coded 0 (not 1-9). Example 2: A female patient has ovarian cancer; the father should be coded 0, and brothers and sons should also be coded 0. • If the medical record does not explicitly state whether the parents, siblings or children had the same cancer, regard them as not affected and code 0. Example 1: The patient has colorectal cancer, and the medical record states: brother, colon cancer; code 001000. Example 2: The patient has lung cancer, and the medical record states: Father-SCLC, Sister-lung adenocarcinoma; code 100100. • If the medical record states only that siblings or children had cancer but the sex is unclear, code A in the siblings or children field. Example 1: The patient has lung cancer, and the medical record states lung cancer (siblings); code 00AA00. Example 2: The patient has colon cancer, and the medical record states only that the children had colorectal cancer; code 0000AA. • If the medical record states that the patient's biological parents are unknown or that there are only adoptive parents, code 9; if there are no biological siblings or no biological children, code X. Example: The patient has lung cancer; the father had colorectal cancer, the mother and the 2 younger sisters had no cancer, and there are no children; code 0000XX. • If the medical record states that the patient does not know whether the parents, siblings or children had the same cancer, code 9. • If the medical record does not record the patient's family history of cancer, code 999999. Examples: Code: Case
000000: The patient has lung cancer; the patient's parents, siblings and children had no lung cancer.
100000: The patient has lung cancer; the medical record states that the patient's father has lung cancer.
010100: The patient has lung cancer; the mother has lung cancer, 1 younger sister also has lung cancer, and the children are unaffected.
000000: The patient has ovarian cancer; the mother is unaffected, the younger sister has lung cancer, and the children are all unaffected.
009900: The patient has colorectal cancer; the parents had no colorectal cancer, the son has lung cancer, but it is unclear whether the siblings had it.
00XXXX: The patient has breast cancer, reports being an only daughter with no children, and neither parent is affected.
002101: The patient has rectal cancer, with several siblings and children: 2 younger brothers, 1 older sister and 1 daughter all have rectal cancer. The parents are unaffected.
011100: The patient has colorectal cancer; the medical record states that the mother, older brother and younger sister all have colorectal cancer.
090110: The patient has rectal cancer; the father had no rectal cancer, the mother is unknown; the older sister and 1 son also have rectal cancer.
999999: After lung cancer was confirmed, the patient left the hospital and did not return; the medical record documents no family history of cancer.
9999XX: A breast cancer patient lost contact with the family, does not know whether the parents and siblings had cancer, and has no children.
100000: The patient has prostate cancer; the father also has prostate cancer, and the older sister has colorectal cancer.
00AA00: The patient has lung cancer; the family history in the medical record states lung cancer (siblings), with no other information.
999999: The patient has liver cancer; the medical record documents no family history of cancer.

entries.label_en: Died without receiving any treatment at the reporting hospital: died or discharged in critical condition after diagnosis at the reporting hospital. Diagnosed at another hospital and died after referral to the reporting hospital.

entries.label_zh: • 僅於申報醫院接受首次療程(首次療程定義詳見總論及指引)，未於他院接受任何首次療程。 首次療程接受其他治療(other treatment)。
entries.label_en: • First course received only at the reporting hospital (for the definition of first course, see the general introduction and guidelines), with no first course received at another hospital. • Other treatment (other treatment) received as the first course.

entries.label_zh: 未於申報醫院接受任何首次療程： 僅於他院接受首次療程。 於申報醫院診斷，但至他院接受後續診療，其首次療程內容不詳。 於他院診斷未治療，至申報醫院諮詢第二意見。主要癌症治療計畫由他院規劃： 接受首次療程後維持輔助性荷爾蒙治療(maintenance adjuvant hormonal therapy)或維持性口服性化療。 因為原轉介醫院放射治療設備不足，接受委託局部追加放射治療，且放射治療模式為其他放射療法 (Other RT)，如brachytherapy, radiosurgery, proton...等。 因為原轉介醫院放射治療設備在療程中途故障，為避免延誤療程，接受委託進行部分放射治療。 維持性口服性化療。
entries.label_en: No first-course treatment received at the reporting hospital: • First course received only at another hospital. • Diagnosed at the reporting hospital but went to another hospital for subsequent care, with first-course content unknown. • Diagnosed at another hospital without treatment and came to the reporting hospital for a second opinion. The main cancer treatment plan is arranged by another hospital: • After the first course, maintenance adjuvant hormonal therapy (maintenance adjuvant hormonal therapy) or maintenance oral chemotherapy. • Because the originally referring hospital had insufficient radiotherapy equipment, received entrusted local boost radiotherapy, and the radiotherapy modality is other radiotherapy (Other RT), such as brachytherapy, radiosurgery, proton, etc. • Because the originally referring hospital's radiotherapy equipment broke down mid-course, received entrusted partial radiotherapy to avoid delaying the course. • Maintenance oral chemotherapy.

entries.label_en: Received part of the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital and part at another hospital. The reporting hospital entrusted another hospital to perform part of the radiation therapy.

entries.label_en: • First course was no treatment or watchful observation (Watchful observation). • First course consisted only of palliative surgery other than tumor resection, pain control, supportive care, or referral to hospice care.

entries.label_en: Earliest date the case visited the reporting hospital as an outpatient or inpatient for this cancer. The first 4 digits are the year (AD), digits 5-6 are the month, and the last 2 digits are the day.

entries.label_en: The date of initial diagnosis is the earliest date this cancer was diagnosed by a physician. The first 4 digits are the year (AD), digits 5-6 are the month, and the last 2 digits are the day.

entries.label_en: Paired organ with unilateral involvement only, but whether it originated on the left or right is unclear.

entries.label_zh: 成對器官，雙側侵犯但起源之側位不清楚，且病歷描述是單一原發。較少見，如下： 雙側卵巢同時有單一組織類型之腫瘤侵犯。 雙側卵巢同時有相同或不同之epithelial組織型態(8000-8799)之腫瘤侵犯。 雙側同時有視網膜芽細胞瘤(retinoblastomas)。 雙側同時有Wilm腫瘤(Wilm tumors)。 雙側瀰漫性肺部結節。
entries.label_en: Paired organs, with bilateral involvement but unclear side of origin, and the medical record describes a single primary. Uncommon, as follows: • Tumor involving both ovaries with a single histologic type. • Tumor involving both ovaries with the same or different epithelial histologic types (8000-8799). • Bilateral retinoblastomas (retinoblastomas). • Bilateral Wilm tumors (Wilm tumors). • Bilateral diffuse lung nodules.

entries.label_zh: 組織病理學確診(Positive histology) 經顯微鏡檢證實，檢查方式為組織病理。
entries.label_en: Positive histology: confirmed by microscopic examination, with histopathology as the method of examination.

entries.label_zh: 細胞學確診(Positive cytology) 經顯微鏡檢證實，檢查方式為細胞學診斷。
entries.label_en: Positive cytology: confirmed by microscopic examination, with cytology as the method of examination.

entries.label_zh: 經顯微鏡檢證實，但未描述其確診方式 經顯微鏡檢證實，但不知為組織病理或是細胞學診斷。
entries.label_en: Confirmed by microscopic examination, but the method of confirmation is not described. Confirmed by microscopic examination, but unknown whether histopathology or cytology.

entries.label_zh: 實驗室檢驗/腫瘤標記檢查為陽性，但未經 顯 微 鏡 檢 證 實 (Positive laboratory test/marker study) 診斷依據為某些特定癌症臨床診斷用之實驗室檢驗/腫瘤標記的臨床確診方式。
entries.label_en: Positive laboratory test/tumor marker study but not confirmed by microscopic examination (Positive laboratory test/marker study). The basis of diagnosis is the clinical confirmation method using laboratory tests/tumor markers for the clinical diagnosis of certain specific cancers.

entries.label_zh: 直接察看診斷為癌症，但未經顯微鏡檢證實 僅由手術或內視鏡方式察看腫瘤，但並未切除腫瘤組織以供顯微鏡檢查。
entries.label_en: Direct visualization diagnosed cancer but not confirmed by microscopic examination. The tumor was viewed only by surgery or endoscopy, without resecting tumor tissue for microscopic examination.

entries.label_zh: 放射線或其他影像學檢查診斷為癌症，但未經顯微鏡檢證實 診斷依據為醫師僅由影像學檢查報告而判斷個案患有癌症。
entries.label_en: Radiologic or other imaging diagnosis of cancer, not confirmed by microscopic examination. The basis of diagnosis is the physician's judgment, from imaging reports alone, that the case has cancer.

entries.label_zh: 僅臨床診斷(不包含 5、6、7) 診斷依據為醫師於病歷上記載個案罹患癌症請參考第一部份「含糊不清字彙」之說明。
entries.label_en: Clinical diagnosis only (excluding 5, 6, 7). The basis of diagnosis is the physician's record in the medical record that the case has cancer; refer to the explanation of "ambiguous terms" in Part 1.

entries.label_zh: 不清楚是否經顯微鏡檢證實 病歷記載個案患有癌症，但未記錄其癌症確診方式(通常為個案分類 3者)。
entries.label_en: Unclear whether confirmed by microscopic examination. The medical record states the case has cancer but does not record the method of cancer confirmation (usually case category 3).

entries.label_zh: 組織病理學確診(Positive histology) 組織病理確診(組織標本經顯微鏡檢查)。
entries.label_en: Positive histology: histopathologic confirmation (tissue specimen examined under the microscope).

entries.label_zh: 細胞學確診(Positive cytology) 細胞學確診(液體細胞經顯微鏡檢查，並沒有組織標本經顯微鏡檢查)。
entries.label_en: Positive cytology: cytologic confirmation (fluid cells examined under the microscope, with no tissue specimen examined under the microscope).

entries.label_zh: 組織病理學確診加上免疫表現分型(immunophenotyping) 陽性同時/或基因(genetic)檢測為陽性 組織學確定為惡性，且免疫表現分型(immunophenotyping)同時/或基因(genetic)檢測結果為陽性。例如：Acute myeloid leukemia 經bone marrow檢查為Acute myeloid leukemia，編碼9861/3；加上基因(genetic)檢測AML with inv(16)(p13;1q22)，編碼 9871/3。
entries.label_en: Histopathologic confirmation plus positive immunophenotyping (immunophenotyping) and/or positive genetic (genetic) testing Histologically confirmed malignant, with positive immunophenotyping (immunophenotyping) and/or genetic (genetic) test results. Example: Acute myeloid leukemia confirmed as Acute myeloid leukemia by bone marrow examination, code 9861/3; plus genetic (genetic) testing showing AML with inv(16)(p13;1q22), code 9871/3.

entries.label_zh: 經顯微鏡檢證實，但未描述其確診方式 經顯微鏡檢證實，但不知為組織病理或是細胞學診斷。
entries.label_en: Confirmed by microscopic examination, but the method of confirmation is not described. Confirmed by microscopic examination, but unknown whether histopathology or cytology.

entries.label_zh: 實驗室檢驗/腫瘤標記檢查為陽性(Positive laboratory test/marker study)或免疫表現分型(immunophenotyping) 陽性同時/或基因(genetic)檢測為陽性 診斷依據為某些特定癌症臨床診斷用之實驗室檢驗/腫瘤標記的臨床確診方式。
entries.label_en: Positive laboratory test/tumor marker study (Positive laboratory test/marker study) or positive immunophenotyping, and/or positive genetic testing. The basis of diagnosis is the clinical confirmation method using laboratory tests/tumor markers for the clinical diagnosis of certain specific cancers.

entries.label_zh: 直接察看診斷為癌症，但未經顯微鏡檢證實 僅由手術或內視鏡方式察看腫瘤，但並未切除腫瘤組織以供顯微鏡檢查。
entries.label_en: Direct visualization diagnosed cancer but not confirmed by microscopic examination. The tumor was viewed only by surgery or endoscopy, without resecting tumor tissue for microscopic examination.

entries.label_zh: 放射線或其他影像學檢查診斷為癌症，但未經顯微鏡檢證實 診斷依據為醫師僅由影像學檢查報告而判斷個案患有癌症。
entries.label_en: Radiologic or other imaging diagnosis of cancer, not confirmed by microscopic examination. The basis of diagnosis is the physician's judgment, from imaging reports alone, that the case has cancer.

entries.label_zh: 僅臨床診斷(不包含 5、6、7) 診斷依據為醫師於病歷上記載個案罹患癌症。
entries.label_en: Clinical diagnosis only (excluding 5, 6, 7) Basis of diagnosis is the physician's statement in the medical record that the case has cancer.

entries.label_zh: 不清楚是否經顯微鏡檢證實 病歷記載個案患有癌症，但未記錄其癌症確診方式(通常為不可分析的個案)。
entries.label_en: Unclear whether confirmed by microscopic examination. The medical record states the case has cancer but does not record the method of cancer confirmation (usually non-analytic cases).

Date of First Microscopic Confirmation.field_zh: 首次顯微鏡檢證實日期

entries.label_zh: 「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」是指此癌症最早顯微鏡檢證實的日期。前 4碼是西元年，第 5、6碼是月，而最後 2碼是日。
entries.label_en: 'Date of first microscopic confirmation' is the earliest date this cancer was confirmed microscopically. The first 4 digits are the year (AD), digits 5-6 are the month, and the last 2 digits are the day.

entries.label_zh: 個案未做顯微鏡檢檢查。
entries.label_en: No microscopic examination was performed for the case.

entries.label_en: Unclear whether the case received microscopic examination. "Date first confirmed by microscopic examination" unknown.

entries.label_zh: 記錄個案在申報醫院開始首次手術治療的日期。
entries.label_en: Record the date the case started first surgical treatment at the reporting hospital.

entries.label_zh:  沒有進行任何手術。 於屍體解剖時才診斷為癌症。
entries.label_en: No surgery performed. Cancer diagnosed only at autopsy.

entries.label_zh:  不知道個案是否有接受手術治療。 個案有接受手術治療，但是接受手術治療的日期不清楚。 僅由死亡證明書得知個案有癌症。
entries.label_en: Unknown whether the case received surgical treatment. The case received surgical treatment, but the date of surgical treatment is unclear. Cancer known only from the death certificate.

entries.label_zh: 未進行原發部位切除手術。  未進行任何手術。 屍體解剖時才診斷為癌症。
entries.label_en: No resection of the primary site performed.  No surgery performed. Cancer diagnosed only at autopsy.

entries.label_zh: 接受以下任兩種以上之局部腫瘤破壞治療者。 TAE(Transcatheter arterial embolization); PEIT(Percutaneous ethanol injection therapy) /PAIT(Percutaneous acetic acid injection therapy); RFA(Heat-Radio-frequency ablation)。 僅適用肝癌個案。
entries.label_en: Received any two or more of the following local tumor destruction treatments. (1) TAE (Transcatheter arterial embolization); (2) PEIT (Percutaneous ethanol injection therapy) /PAIT (Percutaneous acetic acid injection therapy); (3) RFA (Heat-Radio-frequency ablation). Applicable to liver cancer cases only.

entries.label_zh: 接受編號 800內任兩種以上治療和切除手術。 僅適用肝癌個案。
entries.label_en: Received any two or more treatments within code 800 and resection surgery. Applicable to liver cancer cases only.

entries.label_zh: 接受 TAE。 僅適用肝癌個案。
entries.label_en: Received TAE. Applicable to liver cancer cases only.

entries.label_zh: 接受 PEIT/ PAIT。 僅適用肝癌個案。
entries.label_en: Received PEIT/ PAIT. Applicable to liver cancer cases only.

entries.label_zh: 接受 RFA。 僅適用肝癌個案。
entries.label_en: Received RFA. Applicable to liver cancer cases only.

entries.label_zh: 接受 TAE和切除手術。 僅適用肝癌個案。
entries.label_en: Received TAE and resection surgery. Applicable to liver cancer cases only.

entries.label_zh: 接受 PEIT/ PAIT 和切除手術。 僅適用肝癌個案。
entries.label_en: Received PEIT/ PAIT and resection surgery. Applicable to liver cancer cases only.

entries.label_zh: 接受 RFA和切除手術。 僅適用肝癌個案。
entries.label_en: Received RFA and resection surgery. Applicable to liver cancer cases only.

entries.label_zh: 肝癌個案接受非上述之局部腫瘤破壞治療。 僅適用肝癌個案。
entries.label_en: A liver cancer case received local tumor destruction treatment other than the above. Applicable to liver cancer cases only.

entries.label_zh: 僅接受 Transurethral resection (TURP)或 Laser TURP。 僅適用於攝護腺癌個案。
entries.label_en: Received only Transurethral resection (TURP) or Laser TURP. Applicable to prostate cancer cases only.

entries.label_zh: 進行原發部位切除手術。 有針對原發腫瘤進行外科手術。
entries.label_en: Surgical resection of the primary site performed. Surgery performed on the primary tumor.

entries.label_zh: 不詳或不清楚。  不知道個案是否有接受手術治療。 病歷上未記錄。 僅由死亡證明書得知個案有癌症。
entries.label_en: Unknown or unclear.  Unknown whether the case received surgical treatment. Not recorded in the medical record. Cancer known only from the death certificate.

entries.label_zh: 記錄個案於申報醫院裡所接受放射治療的開始日期。前 4 碼是西元年，第5、6碼是月，而最後 2碼是日。
entries.label_en: Record the start date of radiotherapy received by the case at the reporting hospital. The first 4 digits are the year (AD), digits 5-6 are the month, and the last 2 digits are the day.

entries.label_zh: 沒有進行任何的放射治療。由屍體解剖而診斷為癌症。
entries.label_en: • No radiotherapy given. • Cancer diagnosed at autopsy.

entries.label_en: If radiation therapy was planned in the treatment plan but had not yet been given at the most recent follow-up, code 88888888. The treatment date should be updated at the next follow-up.

entries.label_en: Unknown whether the case received radiation therapy. The case received radiation therapy, but the date of radiation therapy is unclear. Cancer known only from the death certificate.

entries.label_zh: 個案未做放射治療。  個案未做放射治療。 個案在死後解剖後才診斷癌症。
entries.label_en: Case received no radiotherapy. • Case received no radiotherapy. • Cancer was diagnosed only at postmortem autopsy.

entries.label_zh:  個案於申報醫院接受放射治療。 申報醫院委託他院執行部分放射治療，視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份。
entries.label_en: • Case received radiotherapy at the reporting hospital. • Partial radiotherapy outsourced by the reporting hospital to another hospital is regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course.

entries.label_en: Unknown. • It is not known whether the case received radiotherapy. • Cancer known only from the death certificate.

entries.label_en: The case's primary site received transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) and systemic chemotherapy.

entries.label_en: The case's primary site received transarterial chemoembolization (TACE), other local chemotherapy and systemic chemotherapy.

entries.label_zh: 個案僅接受局部性化學治療(不包含TACE) 肋膜腔注射 心包膜腔注射 腹腔內注射 膀胱灌注 脊髓腔內注射(intrathecal) 其他局部化學治療(例如：BCNU wafer implantation)
entries.label_en: The case received only local chemotherapy (excluding TACE). Intrapleural injection. Intrapericardial injection. Intraperitoneal injection. Intravesical instillation. Intrathecal injection. Other local chemotherapy (for example: BCNU wafer implantation)

entries.label_en: The case received both systemic and local chemotherapy (excluding TACE).

entries.label_zh: 肝轉移個案接受局部動脈栓塞化學(TACE)及全身性化學治療。
entries.label_en: A liver metastasis case received transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) and systemic chemotherapy.

entries.label_en: A liver metastasis case received transarterial chemoembolization (TACE), other local chemotherapy and systemic chemotherapy.

entries.label_zh: 僅接受臨床試驗化學治療。
entries.label_en: Received only clinical trial chemotherapy.

entries.label_en: Received only double-blind trial chemotherapy.

entries.label_zh: 同時接受化學治療(全身性或/與局部性)及雙盲試驗化學治療。
entries.label_en: Received both chemotherapy (systemic and/or local) and double-blind trial chemotherapy.

entries.label_en: Chemotherapy was part of the planned first course of treatment, but had not yet been performed at the time of abstraction.

entries.label_zh: Code papillary microcarcinoma of thyroid to papillary microcarcinoma 8341. Note: For thyroid primaries only, the term micropapillary/papillary microcarcinoma does not refer to a specific histologic type. In North America, it means the papillary component of the tumor is minimal or occult. We concur with the statement above; however, it should be noted that not all cases of thyroid cancer from Taiwan report tumor size. Therefore, we continue to use the morphology code 8341 to differentiate very small or occult papillary adenocarcinoma according to the WHO Classification of Tumours of Endocrine Organs.
